items.quote: what is interesting is that in the non -defense segment, n ow we have about 22.5 % of our total order

items.statement: Existing contracts are fixed price with no cost escalation impact; new bids will factor commodity uncertainty
items.quote: For all the new contracts which we are yet to sign or where we are bidding, we will factor this aspect of uncertainty also. In the existing contracts, just to say, all the contracts are fixed price contracts and so are our orders with our subcontractors or vendors. So, there is no impact as such.

items.statement: Variable depth sonar on ASW vessels is buyer-furnished developmental item with no financial impact on PBGS or bank guarantees
items.quote: The variable depth sonar, it is a developmental item. It's a buyer-furnished item. So, we are not impacted by the non-availability or availability of that item. What I am trying to say, there is no financial impact with respect to the bank guarantee or PBGS, the firm's bank guarantee.

items.statement: P-17 Bravo RFP expected in current quarter, contract could be signed by end of FY27; MCM and LPD RFPs by end of FY27, contracts in FY28
items.quote: We expect the RFP for P-17 Bravo to come out in the current quarter. And the RFP for the other two projects could come by end of the financial year. So, if the RFP for the P-17 Bravo comes by 1st Quarter, then the contract could be completed as early as end of the current financial year, that is FY27, going by the NGC trend. And the other two projects in the next financial year.

items.statement: Expansion includes two brownfield facilities in West Bengal and two greenfield facilities (one in West Bengal, one in Gujarat) supported by INR 69,725 cr revitalization package
items.quote: The projects that we have taken on for expansion is for creation of two Brownfield shipbuilding facilities in West Bengal, and two Greenfield shipbuilding facilities, one in West Bengal and one in Gujarat. What we envisage is with the revitalization package for shipbuilding that has been promulgated by the government, which is to the tune of around INR 69,725 crore.

items.statement: FY26 revenue INR 7,002 crore (+38% YoY), PAT INR 748 crore (+42% YoY), best-ever financial performance
items.quote: When we take the full financial year, I am happy to inform you that we have recorded a revenue from operations of INR 7,002 crore, registering a growth of 38% over the last financial year. Similarly, our profit after tax has moved up from INR 527 crore to INR 748 crore, registering a growth of 42%.

items.statement: Guided organic revenue CAGR of 14% to 15% over next 3 years driven by patient volumes, RPP growth, price increases and selective acquisitions
items.quote: Over the next 3 years, the vision is to grow at a CAGR of 14% to 15% in revenue . Organic revenues would come primarily via patient volumes, RPP growth , and price increases.

items.statement: Target sustainable group EBITDA margin of 27% to 28% over next 3 years with Core Diagnostics reaching 20%+ margin
items.quote: We are going to reimagine our processes through automation and technology enablement to drive center productivity and margin expansion with the goal of achieving a sustainable group EBITDA margin of 27% to 28% over the next 3 years

items.statement: Expect 125-150 bps EBITDA margin improvement in FY27
items.quote: So we'll definitely be looking at about 125 to 150 bps improvement in the coming year.

items.statement: Estimate 8% to 9% patient volume growth for FY27 with remaining 5% from realization improvement
items.quote: So, about 8% to 9% of patient volume growth is what we are estimating for the coming fiscal for sure, right? And the remaining 5% will be coming from the realization.

items.statement: FY26 capex was INR 65 crores; future capex focused on targeted network additions, specialty test expansion, technology upgrades and digital capabilities
items.quote: Now, talking about the capex for the year. We have incurred a capex the capex stood at INR 65 crores.

items.statement: Mini hub capex estimated at INR 30-40 lakh per center, similar to satellite lab
items.quote: About INR 30 lakh, INR 40 lakh is approximately what we are estimating at this point in time.

items.statement: Plan to build 100 mini hubs over 3 years (50 upgraded existing centers, 50 new) and add 1,500 collection centers to reach 1:35 lab-to-center ratio
items.quote: We're also building a network of 100 mini hubs over the next 3 years, which will encompass pathology and basic radiology to service retail and corporate clientele.

items.statement: FY26 organic EBITDA margin expanded 140 bps to 25.9%; Q4 organic EBITDA margin 27.2% vs 18.5% YoY
items.quote: On a normalized basis, organic margins expanded by around 140 basis points to 25.9%, supported by sustained productivity improvements, ongoing lab platform upgrades , and consolidation initiatives.

items.statement: Core Diagnostics reached high-single-digit EBITDA margin in Q4 FY26, on track for 20%+ in 3 years
items.quote: For Core Diagnostics, we have committed that within 4 quarters of doing the acquisition, we would move from a negative 2% EBITDA to a high -single-digit EBITDA in Q4. We have completed this mission.

items.statement: No price increase taken in Q4 FY26 due to GST reasons; price lever remains opportunity for later in year
items.quote: It is also important to note that unlike last year, we did not take a price increase in quarter 4 due to GST reasons.

items.statement: Not currently planning price hike in FY27 but would not hesitate if needed as year progresses
items.quote: Well, at this point of time, we are not looking at a price increase. But as the year progresses, if there is a need for us to do it, we would not hesitate to do so.

items.statement: Patient volume growth healthy at 7-8% range supported by lab additions, center expansion and digital acceleration
items.quote: Patient volume growth remained healthy in the 7% to 8 % range, supported by the lab additions made over the last few years, continuous center expansion quarter after quarter, and the acceleration of our digital agenda.

items.statement: TruHealth contribution at 19% of FY26 revenue, targeting beyond 25% in next 2-3 years with vital checks, radiology and consults added to packages
items.quote: Well, I mean, this can definitely go beyond 25% as well, I mean, in the next 2 to 3 years period.

items.statement: M&A opportunities exist but remain selective; quality of many acquisition targets may not meet standards
items.quote: But we generally find that the quality of many of the assets available for acquisition may not meet our standards for what we would like to buy.

items.statement: FY29 gross margin target of 70% achieved in Q4 FY26 at 70.2%
items.quote: In fact, we have achieved our FY29 guidance of 70% this year itself as we end the year at 70.2% in Q4.

items.statement: Target free cash flow positive for India business by FY28
items.quote: That -- Devanshu, you're absolutely right, that's the target that we have, and that's what we are working towards as far as India part of the business is concerned.

items.statement: Aim to reach free cash flow neutral over next 4 to 6 quarters
items.quote: We feel that the goal that we have set ourselves to, to get to a free cash flow consultive number which funds for the growth that we have set ourselves for, which is around 60 to 80 restaurants on an annual basis, we should be able to get to that state over next -- our sense is that anywhere between 4 to -- over the next 4 to 6 quarters, we should be able to kind of start getting to that number.

items.statement: Net 68 stores opened in FY26 within guidance range of 60-80 per year
items.quote: This year, we've opened a net of 68 stores, which is within our guidance range of opening 60 to 80 restaurants every year.

items.statement: Gross margin improved 3.2% over 5 years to 70.2% in Q4 FY26
items.quote: Gross profit margins are also up 3.2% for the 5-year period, an average increase of 80 basis points every year. In fact, we have achieved our FY29 guidance of 70% this year itself as we end the year at 70.2% in Q4.

items.statement: Restaurant EBITDA margin doubled over 5 years to 11.6% in FY26
items.quote: On top of the 3.2% GP improvement, we have added anoth er 3.2% in the 5 -year block to restaurant EBITDA margins, taking us to 11.6% for

items.statement: Company EBITDA margin improved from 2.5% in FY23 to 5.8% in FY26
items.quote: Similarly, on the company EBITDA level, we were at 2.5% in FY '23. We've got to 5.8% in FY26.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 SSSG at 6.3%, highest in 12 quarters; full year SSSG at 4%
items.quote: We ended the fourth quarter with a 6.3% SSSG growth, which is the highest that we have achieved in the last 12 quarters, and that momentum continues.

items.statement: Dine-in traffic grown 18% over last 3 years
items.quote: In fact, in the last 3 years, we have grown traffic in our dine-in business by 18%.

items.statement: 91% of orders now digital; 51% growth in monthly active users on CRM
items.quote: 91% of all our orders are now digital, which gives us a significant control on not only the cash elements of our busi ness but also the consumer element of our business

items.statement: Café offering now available in all restaurants; target INR25,000 per restaurant per day in 4-5 years
items.quote: Our ambition is over the next 4, 5 years, to get that volume to come somewhere close to INR25,000 per restaurant per day.

items.statement: New electric broiler uses half the utilities of old broiler; rollout nearly complete across India
items.quote: We also continue the rest of the P&L efficiency, whether it's utilities through our solar efforts, our efforts to have launched this new broiler, which uses half the utilities that old broiler used.

items.statement: Indonesia Popeyes business struggling with 24 stores; will align with new promoters; not part of future portfolio
items.quote: On the Popeyes side, we have now 25 restaurants, we -- I think, recently closed one, so we're down to 24. That business is struggling, and there's reasons for it because with a small portfolio like that, we have no ways to -- unless there's a significant capital commitment there to move that business to -- from 25 to several hundred restaurants, the path becomes very, very difficult.

items.statement: Indonesia Burger King positive on EBITDA, ADS, dine-in SSSG; needs ~4 more quarters to cover G&A
items.quote: We believe that it still has -- from the current trends that we are seeing as far as Burger King is concerned, it still is at least around -- again, here also, we feel that it's at least another 4 quarters away for the Burger King side of the business to be able to start recoverin g for its own G&A

items.statement: INR20 crores infused in Indonesia via preferential shares in April 2026
items.quote: And simultaneously, you have also infused about INR20 crores in April '26, via preferential shares.

items.statement: Acquisition by Inspira Global nearing completion; revised outlook to be shared in Q1 after deal closes
items.quote: As you are all aware, we are set to be acquired by Inspira Global. The transaction is nearing completion, and we will come to you with our revised outlook in Q1 once the deal is done.

items.statement: Expects organic growth and margin expansion in FY27 driven by Centers of Excellence and AI implementation; pro forma EBITDA would at least double with Bluetile consolidation
items.quote: Nazara's existing businesses are expected to drive organic growth and expansion of margins due to two things. One is the output or outcome of the Centers of Excellence activity that we have been doing in FY '26. Second is a stronger, faster implementation of AI and how that plays out for us.

items.statement: Bluetile CY25 revenue INR 1,460 crores and EBITDA INR 254 crores; consolidation expected from Q1 FY27 pending Spanish FDI approval
items.value: INR 1,460 crores revenue and INR 254 crores EBITDA
items.quote: If you look at Bluetile, their C Y '25 numbers were around INR 1,460 crores revenue and INR 254 crores of EBITDA. The EBITDA profile for C Y '25 for Bluetile was similar to what Nazara's reporting for FY '26.

items.statement: Curve Games plans at least 6 new game releases in current year including Wax Heads, Sovereign Tower, Dragon Shelter; increasing development spend to build pipeline
items.quote: We expect to launch at least 6 new releases in this current year, maybe a couple more. Wax Heads actually released last week. And other releases in the summer will include Sovereign Tower and Dragon Shelter.

items.statement: Curve Games targets 50% margin on signed games; expects to maintain current high margins of 39% despite new investments
items.quote: Yes, our margin target is always 50% on any game that we sign. Ultimately, we are a publisher, so royalties payable to the developers can vary depending on the agreement and the risk.

items.statement: Sportskeeda expects margins to increase in FY27 on potentially smaller revenue base through cost optimization
items.quote: We actually expect margins to increase in FY '27 on potentially a smaller base. But I can also have Mayank come in here.

items.statement: Kiddopia returned to subscriber growth in Q3 and Q4 FY26 with improving unit economics; plans more app launches and IP integrations in FY27
items.quote: Kiddopia had returned to subscriber growth in the previous quarter and has sustained that journey, with improving unit economics, while Animal Jam delivered meaningful margin expansion during the year.

items.statement: Animal Jam launched Monster High IP integration in Q1 FY27; expanding to Roblox and launching new hyper-casual game in Q2 FY27
items.quote: In Q1 of FY '27, we launched our first IP integration with Mattel into Animal Jam through their Monster High property, and it was successful in April. And we look for quarterly updates that will go on over the next six quarters.

items.statement: NODWIN plans to raise $100-200 million independently (primary and secondary) and prepare for IPO as soon as timing is right
items.quote: NODWIN is looking both to raise funds between $100 million to $200 million independently which should be a mixture of primary and secondary, and then also prepare for an IPO as soon as possible.

items.statement: Nazara evaluating monetization of non-core businesses (NODWIN, Sportskeeda, AdTech) to redeploy in core gaming; expects actions in FY27-FY28
items.quote: We will look at potentially monetizing non -core businesses for us. This could be NODWIN, it could be Sportskeeda, or it could be the adtech business in due course. We are not in any hurry, but we definitely see the potential to unlock value and redeploy it in our core gaming business.

items.statement: Fusebox new IPs (Big Brother, Bigg Boss, Traitors) will take potentially a couple of years to meaningfully offset seasonality; three Love Island seasons and three Big Brother seasons planned for FY27
items.quote: With regards to the other IPs that we have - Big Brother, Bigg Boss, Traitors - offsetting some of that seasonality, it will take potentially a couple of years for them to meaningfully take a chunk out of th at seasonality

items.statement: Bluetile applying AI across all functions (creative marketing, product development, ad monetization, data segmentation) using LLMs and reinforcement learning; team capacity increased exponentially
items.quote: So, from creative marketing, marketing operations, product development, technical development, ad monetization, to data segmentation, we are starting to apply AI in different capacities, both through LLMs and through different complex algorithms such as reinforcement learning and other types of AI.

items.statement: AdTech pivoting to high-margin product-led DSP business (Vizibl); temporary revenue decline due to reduced focus on traditional declining AdTech and UK new homes market challenges
items.quote: We are focusing a lot more on our product-driven part of the business. We relaunched our DSP Vizibl about 2.5 years ago, and we are seeing really high growth in that area. So, what we are doing is reinvesting in that, both from a sales and marketing standpoint.

items.statement: NODWIN core business growing 25-35% organically; pursuing Global South expansion strategy across Philippines to Mexico; India remains anchor market
items.quote: And natural growth has been sitting between 25 % and 35% of the core business itself . And positioning ourselves as a live youth media company, while gaming remains at the core heart of what we do, has allowed us to have very meaningful conversations.

items.statement: FY26 consolidated revenue INR 1,829 crores (+13% YoY), EBITDA INR 255 crores (+66% YoY), EBITDA margin 13.9%; Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin 19.5%
items.value: INR 1,829 crores revenue, INR 255 crores EBITDA, 13.9% margin
items.quote: Nazara delivered FY '26 revenue of INR 1,829 crores, up 13% year -on-year, and EBITDA of INR 255 crores, up 66% year -on-year, with our EBITDA margin expanding to 13.9%.

items.statement: Gaming segment FY26 revenue INR 1,072 crores (+107% YoY), EBITDA INR 265 crores (+157% YoY), EBITDA margin 24.7%; PC/console publishing 39% EBITDA margin
items.value: INR 1,072 crores revenue, INR 265 crores EBITDA, 24.7% margin
items.quote: Within this, our gaming business delivered particularly strong growth and profitability, with FY '26 revenue growing 107% year -on-year to INR 1,072 crores and EBITDA growing 157% to INR 265 crores, resulting in an EBITDA margin of 24.7%.

items.statement: NODWIN wrote off INR 50 crores goodwill from OML assets acquisition (NH7 Weekender) 3-4 years ago; operational EBITDA profitable in FY26
items.quote: NODWIN, which wrote off some goodwill it was carrying of INR 50 crores relating to an acquisition of OML assets done 3-4 years back, predominantly coming from NH7 Weekender, which has not delivered the cash flows that were projected at the time the goodwill was established.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth guidance maintained at around 25% with EBITDA margin of 20-22%
items.quote: We have already maintained that we will be growing the revenue by around 25% and EBITDA should be in the range of somewhere around 20% to 22% on a very realistic basis. So, we will stick to that.

items.statement: Capex of INR100 crore in FY27 and INR175 crore in FY28 for Jolva greenfield project
items.quote: Current financial year INR100 crores and INR175 crores in the next financial year.

items.statement: Good order visibility in PASC segment till end of calendar year 2026 and continuing into 2027
items.quote: In terms of orders, we have good visibility till end of calendar year -- current calendar year. And I assume the same to remain -- same to continue even for the next year as well.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 20-22% despite raw material cost increases, supported by operating leverage and price pass-through
items.quote: So there also, we stay with 20% to 22%.

items.statement: Raw material prices (amines) up 30-40% due to geopolitical issues; most increases passed to customers, some cases pending
items.quote: But the prices have gone up by nearly 30%, 40%, so that is a deterrent. In most of the cases, we have been able to pass on that price increase to the customer.

items.statement: SDA demand growing consistently; expect 20% growth in FY27 to INR250-300 crore, with Euro 7 transition driving uptick from July-August
items.quote: We expect to grow at least by 20% in this current financial year. We should reach anywhere number between INR250 crores to INR300 crores this year.

items.statement: Electrolyte Salts to contribute 8-10% of FY27 revenue; hybrid battery application commercialization starting Q3 FY27
items.quote: Around 8% to 10% that we had already informed in last earning call, and we are still going by that.

items.statement: Pharma commercialization begins Q1 FY27 with one product, two more from Q3; targeting INR70-75 crore new revenue in FY27
items.quote: On the upper side, we should see a revenue in the range of about, I believe, somewhere close to INR70 crores, INR75 crores in this financial year.

items.statement: Semiconductor chemicals: first plant-scale trial dispatch in Q1 FY27; commercialization expected end of 2028/early 2029
items.quote: Plan scale trials for our first product have been completed successfully and its dispatch would happen in the current quarter.

items.statement: Geopolitical conflicts causing raw material cost spikes and supply disruptions; amine availability disrupted for 2-3 weeks in March
items.quote: There was a phase of 2 or 3 weeks when nearly amines were not available at all. Immediately -- more or less immediately after this Iran issue started.

items.statement: Dahej facility at 80-85% utilization; peak revenue potential INR850-900 crore with minor bottleneck capex of INR10-12 crore/year
items.quote: From the current facility, it would be somewhere around INR850 crores to INR900 crores of revenue.

items.statement: Jolva Phase 1 revenue potential INR400-500 crore; will launch 2 agro intermediates with in-house developed technology
items.quote: Jolva facility will go in multiple phases. For Phase 1, we estimate the revenue potential in the range of INR400 crores to INR500 crores.

items.statement: SDA market share gains expected with Euro 7 as company is well-positioned from start unlike Euro 6; customer dual-sourcing limits max share per product
items.quote: Euro 7, we are very well in time, we have our foot in the door right from beginning. So, we'll gradually see our market share keep on rising.

items.statement: FY27 Crop Protection EBITDA margin guided at 15-17% long-term range
items.quote: So on the long-term perspective, we stick to a guideline of 15% to 17%. So we believe that in FY27, we will be somewhere in this range only.

items.statement: FY27 Crop Protection expects double-digit top-line growth with better profitability than Q4
items.quote: So we believe that there will be double -digit growth in top line in Crop Protection segment, which will have a better profitability going forward than quarter 4.

items.statement: FY27 Pigments revenue guided at INR500-600 crore with EBITDA margin much better than 3.3%
items.quote: So this segment would be in the range of -- in the top line point of view, it will be in the range of somewhere INR500 crores to INR600 crores. But from the profitability, which was in the last financial year, we were in the range of 3.3% from EBITDA point of view. We see this year it will be much better than the last

items.statement: FY27 dividend planned with Board approval based on better revenue and profitability
items.quote: In FY 27, we believe that we will have better revenue and better profitability. And based on that, in this financial year, FY27, with the Board approval, we'll try to provide a reasonably good dividend to the investors.

items.statement: FY27 capex limited to routine INR35-40 crore, no significant capex
items.quote: So as far as the capex is concerned, there won't be any significant capex in the current financial year. Only the routine capex to the tune of about INR35 crores to INR40 crores will be there.

items.statement: Nano DAP, Nano NPK, Nano Zinc approved; commercial production starts Kharif season at Sanand with no new capex
items.quote: Commercial production of these products are expected to commence during the Kharif season this year.

items.statement: TiO2 plant suspended due to sulphuric acid >INR30/kg (was <INR5) and high utility costs; awaiting DGTR anti-dumping decision in 1-2 months
items.quote: Currently, the sulphuric acid price is more than INR30 per kg, which used to be below INR10. In fact, in the normal time, it used to be below INR 5.

items.statement: Geopolitical war (US-Iran) caused raw material cost spike; sulphur/sulphuric acid prices uncontrolled until Strait of Hormuz reopens
items.quote: We believe that -- let's hope the war ends very soon, Strait of Hormuz opens up very fast, and that will bring down the sulphur and sulphuric acid price to the reasonable levels.

items.statement: FY26 standalone EBITDA grew 27% YoY to INR228.7 crore; consolidated EBITDA margin 8.1% vs 6.9%
items.quote: In FY26, on standalone basis, revenue stood at INR 2,091 crores, up by 4% Y -o-Y, and our EBITDA grew by 27% Y-o-Y to INR228.7 crores.

items.statement: Crop Nutrition segment expects significant top-line and bottom-line growth over next 2-5 years with better profitability
items.quote: And going forward for the next 2 to 5 years period, we see significant growth happening in the Nutrition segment with better profitability.

items.statement: FY26 debt repaid ~INR160 crore; standalone debt INR528 crore (0.30x D/E), consolidated INR722 crore (0.47x D/E)
items.quote: In FY26, we have made a debt repayment of approximately INR160 crores.

items.statement: Amalgamation of Kilburn Chemicals and Meghmani Crop Nutrition filed; voting on June 6 for operational/financial synergies
items.quote: The scheme of amalgamation which we have filed and the Court has already directed to have the voting on June 6.

items.statement: Ended FY2026 with Rs.2,000 Cr order book; all fixed-fee models, no transaction-fee contracts; includes marquee wins from SBI, ICICI, HDFC securing 85% of FY2027 target
items.quote: We end FY2026 with a solid order book, not only from size, which is Rs. 2,000 Crores, but even if we say so, it is high quality wins. None of these deals is linked to any transaction fee linked contract. All of them are fixed fee models.

items.statement: FY2026 capex Rs.350 Cr (up from Rs.100 Cr in FY24/25); includes tech investment Rs.40 Cr (1.6% of revenue) and Rs.15 Cr in gig delivery model
items.quote: In FY2026, in the middle of the storm, we upped our capex spend significantly to drive higher growth in the coming years, and we have invested Rs.350 Crores of capex in FY2026.

items.statement: Q4 FY2026 EBITDA margin improved 280 bps QoQ to 19% EBIT margin; full-year FY2026 EBIT margin contracted 360 bps to 15.6%; targeting 25% EBITDA margin in FY2027
items.quote: Overall EBIT margins in Q4 have gone from last year Q4 was 22.6%, they dipped to 15% in Q3 and have come back up to 19% in Q4 of this year. For the full year EBIT margins for FY2026, they have contracted by 360 bps from 19.2% to 15.6%.

items.statement: Seeing banks shift from cash dispensers to recyclers (cash acceptance, video KYC, card issuance); 6,000-7,000 ATMs in RFP pipeline mostly fixed-price or product purchase; consumption weakness risk Rs.50-70 Cr if currency supply dip persists
items.quote: In FY2027, we know the 6,000 to 7,000 units that we see in different stages of bank RFP pipeline planning are mostly all either product purchase and with subsequent services outsourcing or will be a fixed price outsourcing deals.

items.statement: Board approved Rs.168 Cr buyback (~3% equity) at Rs.340/share; post-buyback cash balance Rs.650 Cr retained for growth; CEO not participating
items.quote: With clarity on our capital needs and our cash balance of Rs. 650 Crores, the board has approved Rs. 168 Crores buyback, roughly 3% of our outstanding equity shares, at Rs.340 price point.

items.statement: FSS acquisition to close end of Q1 FY2027; will consolidate managed services (move from #5 to #3), enable cross-sell to mid-sized private banks, shift contracts to fixed-fee; Securens acquisition closed and accretive in FY2027
items.quote: In Q4, we signed our contract deal with FSS for the managed services business. This not only helps us consolidate the managed services segment, but more importantly for CMS, it allows us an entry into midsized private banks for cross-selling.

items.statement: Targeting 13-14% services revenue CAGR over next 4 years (vs 12% past 4 years); three platforms target Rs.20,000 Cr TAM; Q1 FY2027 revenue run-rate target Rs.650 Cr
items.quote: Over the next four years, we see our opportunity to accelerate this growth to a 13% to 14% CAGR, which is more in line with our historical growth of 15% CAGR.

items.statement: Guided for 20-25% EBITDA margin
items.quote: we are guiding for a 20% to 25% EBITDA margin

items.statement: Executable order book stands at INR 697 crores as of 31 March 2026
items.quote: our executable order book as of 31 March , 2026 stands at approximately INR 697 crores

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin was around 30%
items.quote: this quarter, we had done around 30% EBITDA margin

items.statement: Kavach opportunity is large, long-duration and strategically important
items.quote: The Kavach opportunity is large, long -duration and strategically important for us

items.statement: Railway payments are well streamlined with no bad debt risk, just cycle timing
items.quote: railway payments are very well streamlined. There is absolutely no issue in railway payments. It's just a cycle and a process

items.statement: Order execution cycle typically 18-24 months, aiming to maintain similar growth trajectory
items.quote: typically, what we have seen is until now, we have seen an 18 to 24 month order execution cycle

items.statement: Zero-emission mobility is a strong pillar with active traction in NTPC and other inquiries
items.quote: Zero-emission mobility is a very strong pillar of this strategy because it can significantly improve overall energy efficiency

items.statement: Mainboard migration in process, no specific timeline given
items.quote: we are in the process. It's just a matter of -- very difficult to give a timeline to it. But we have already been on the journey

items.statement: Semiconductor project substructure work to start July 2026; production in 24-30 months from July
items.quote: Our target is to start the substructure work from July. And broadly, it should 24 to 30 months from that time.

items.statement: Logistics cost impact INR14-15 crores in Q4; transport cost up INR100-120/ton in Feb, INR200-220/ton by March
items.quote: On a weighted average basis across the quarter, probably around INR14 crores to INR15 crores was the impact because of the higher logistics cost.

items.statement: Industrial salt volume 1.1M tons in Q4 (-7.2% YoY) impacted by 120k tons customer deferrals and 250k tons logistics issues; full year 4.2M tons (+22% YoY)
items.quote: Volumes were impacted by nearly 120,000 tons due to customer deferrals on account of the US-Iran conflict and around 250,000 tons of shipments we could not complete because of the logistics issues.

items.statement: Idealis Mudchemie: Gujarat plant production-ready awaiting approvals; Nagri plant redefining product roadmap; expect lean H1, ramp in H2 FY27
items.quote: We expect to have a fairly lean first half of this year in terms of Idealis Mudchemie, but we expect that the second half will start getting to a larger ramp.

items.statement: SOP plant reengineering underway; plant trials expected Q1 FY27, higher production H2 FY27
items.quote: This program is currently underway, and we expect to complete plant trials in the first quarter of this year and go into a higher level of production in the second half of the year.

items.statement: Standalone cash INR37 crores, consolidated INR55 crores as of March 31, 2026
items.value: INR37 crores standalone, INR55 crores consolidated
items.quote: Yes, just stand-alone cash, cash equivalent bank balances, INR37 crores and consolidated is INR55 crores.

items.statement: Three strategic priorities: consolidate core salt/bromine, scale derivatives/oilfield/SOP, invest in advanced materials (batteries/semiconductors)
items.quote: As we look forward, I think we have established three clear strategic priorities for the company. The first one is to consolidate the core salt and bromine business. Secondly, to scale up our derivatives, oilfield and SOP businesses...

items.statement: Management will not provide specific revenue guidance for FY27 due to market volatility but commits to doubling market growth rate of 15-16%
items.quote: We say we'll outgrow the market, we'll penetrate into each and every segment, and we'll double the growth of market growth is what the commitment that we have done.

items.statement: EMS business working capital days to improve by 8-10 days in coming years
items.quote: You can rest assured that Kaynes stand-alone, the EMS business will continue to be cash positive, and we'll be improving it at least by about 8 to 10 days in the years to come in this segment.

items.statement: Metering business cash flow to turn positive within 3 quarters of FY27
items.quote: We will reverse the trend. That's what we can say. But we have a very clear road map of bringing it back in 3 quarters to track in this metering business also.

items.statement: Consolidated order book remains strong at over INR9,000 crores
items.quote: Our order book continues to be stronger at INR9,000 crores plus.

items.statement: OSAT revenue visibility of over INR25,000 million over next 5 years
items.quote: In OSAT, the order outlook for both the current year and the medium term remains strong with revenue visibility of over INR25,000 million over the next 5 years.

items.statement: OSAT Unit 1 fully operational, Unit 2 in commercialization by Q2 FY26
items.quote: I am pleased by the trajectory of our 2 new growth engines in OSAT. Unit 1 is fully operational, and Unit 2 is in commercialization by Q2 '26.

items.statement: PCB and OSAT FY27 revenue expected at INR300-400 crores and INR250-300 crores respectively
items.quote: I'm sure and certain we will do a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.

items.statement: Rail business margins expected north of 30%
items.quote: And the margins are going to be north of current 30% plus.

items.statement: Targeting 30% of revenue from new product development (NPD) led solutions in coming years
items.quote: Our goal is to steadily increase the contribution of NPD-led and value-added solutions to nearly 30% of the total revenue in the coming years.

items.statement: EV segment grew 28% in FY26 despite largest 2-wheeler customer dropping 90% production
items.quote: And you can see our growth in the EV segment this year is about 28% growth despite the fact that one of our largest customers in 2-wheelers has dropped the production significantly by about 90%.

items.statement: Rail business expected to grow 20-25% in FY27 driven by Kavach and new global rail products
items.quote: So rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25% because of the se coming in

items.statement: Geopolitical disruptions (West Asia conflict) caused customer deferments and supply chain delays impacting near-term revenue timing
items.quote: Near-term top line performance did not fully meet market expectations, primarily due to geopolitical disruption, especially the West Asia conflict, which led to last-minute customer deferment, supply chain delays and product timing shift.

items.statement: Smart meter installation delays in rural areas causing receivables buildup of INR1,365 crores
items.quote: On the receivables of the metering business, it's about INR1,365 crores, including the -- in the total revenue, the receivables on this business.

items.statement: Intangible assets increased by INR320 crores due to Iskraemeco and August Electronics acquisitions
items.quote: The intangible asset that has been c apitalized on these 2 is about INR320 crores, and there was a clear thing on what is the order book and it's based on the current accounting standards, and we did INR320

items.statement: Core EMS working capital days improved from 83 days in FY24 to 53 days in FY26
items.quote: On a like-to-like basis, we would like to bring it to your attention that the core EMS business has demonstrated a significant improvement in the efficiency as committed earlier with the working capital days reducing from 83 days in FY '24 to 53 days in FY '26.

items.statement: FY27 net square feet addition target at least 20% above FY26 (~100,000 sq ft)
items.quote: But at least for now, we should be able to expect at least 20% more than last year's square feet addition.

items.statement: FY27 SSSG expected similar to slightly better than FY26's 3%
items.quote: So, we do anticipate a similar to a little bit better SSSG numbers than we've achieved this year.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth expected to exceed FY26's 13.1%
items.quote: But broadly, if I have to give you, it should be more than the guidance that more than what we achieved last year '25-'26.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin target 17.5%-18% vs FY26 15.76%
items.quote: And our target, with the plan of action on expansion and Varamahalakshmi format it should be possible that we should at least be in the 17.5% to 18% range this year.

items.statement: FY27 store expansion focused on Karnataka (Kalamandir) and Andhra/Tamil Nadu (Varamahalakshmi Skills), ~60-40 split Kalamandir:Varamahalakshmi
items.quote: Broadly, I think we should implement approximately in the range of 60-40 between Kalamandir and Varamahalakshmi format this year.

items.statement: Gross margin maintained at ~42% despite new formats; FY27 target to hold gross margin
items.quote: One of the top high priority KPIs for us is to maintain the gross margin irrespective of the fact we are coming with the newer formats and lesser gross margin stores.

items.statement: Q4 EBITDA margin impacted by ~INR4 cr bonus (2 bps) and ad spend timing; FY27 EBITDA expected at full-year FY26 level +50 bps
items.quote: Otherwise, we should be able to expect a decent EBITDA about the full year EBITDA plus at least 50 basis points in the next year.

items.statement: Wedding calendar FY27 has 5-10% more dates than FY26, spread across quarters
items.quote: I think in terms of the absolute number, we have around extra days than compared to last year. So yes, I think more than 5% to 10% of extra dates is what we have compared to last year.

items.statement: Varamahalakshmi + Valli formats drove FY26 growth; Varamahalakshmi now 52% of sales
items.quote: 52% of the overall thing. So, the component of Varamahalakshmi is increasing in the overall pie.

items.statement: KLM format declined ~3% in FY26; 9,000 sq ft reduced for margin improvement; revival plan underway
items.quote: So, KLM, I think the decline has been around low-single-digit, about 3% or so is the overall decline for KLM format.

items.statement: Company debt-free; internal accruals sufficient for FY27 expansion and next 2-3 years; no borrowing planned
items.quote: Since the company is totally debt-free and the company has enough resources for completing the entire expansion with the internal generation, there will not be any further borrowings this year.

items.statement: Inventory per sq ft reduced from INR11,533 to INR10,480; continuous optimization balanced with sales
items.quote: We have reduced the inventory per square feet by around INR1,000. What was around INR11,533 has come down to INR10,480 or so.

items.statement: Store payback: Varamahalakshmi 8-9 months; maturity to avg EBITDA margin 1.5-2 years; Kalamandir slightly longer
items.quote: Varamahalakshmi format will give a payback within 8 to 9 months, whereas to reach the EBITDA margins to get the store mature, it will be approximately 1.5 years to 2 years.

items.statement: Revenue target of around INR1,600-1,632 crores with 18-20% growth for FY27
items.quote: So our revenue will be in line with our target of the next year, that is almost like around INR1,600 crores or INR1,632 crores. We've targeted around 18% to 20% growth.

items.statement: Order book of INR1,514 crores as of March 31, 2026 with 63% exports and 37% domestic
items.quote: As of 31st March, 2026, our order book stood at INR1,514 crores, providing strong revenue visibility for the coming quarters of this approximately 63% is from exports and 37% from the domestic market.

items.statement: Expect INR450-500 crores order inflow per quarter in FY27
items.quote: And our order booking will be also growing in the similar speed of around INR450 crores to INR500 crores every quarter.

items.statement: New Kandla facility on 7 acres near port, commissioning in 9-10 months for ultra-large tanks up to 500 tons
items.quote: We have acquired approximately 7 acres of land near the Kandla Port on a 30-year lease basis, the facility is expected to be commissioned within approximately 9 to 10 months.

items.statement: EBITDA margin of 23.8% for FY26, maintained within 21-24% guidance range
items.quote: Our EBITDA margin is 23.8% for FY '26, remained in line with or better than the guidance provided earlier, demonstrating disciplined execution despite headwind arising from the U.S. tariffs.

items.statement: Demand fundamentals robust across geographies; primary constraint is logistics and supply chain, not market slowdown
items.quote: The key takeaway is that demand fundamentals remain robust across the geographies. The primary constraint continued to be logistics and supply chain related challenges rather than the slowdown in the market demand.

items.statement: Project orders now exceed 60% of order book vs 30% earlier, shifting from standard to non-standard products
items.quote: My product mix is changing. My standard tanks is reducing, and my non-standard orders are increasing. If you see earlier, it was just 30% project orders. Now we have more than 60% project orders in our order book.

items.statement: Expect INR1,200 crores of current INR1,514 crores order book to execute in FY27
items.quote: Order book of or pending order of around INR1,514 crores. So out of that, at least INR1,200 crores will be executed this year.

items.statement: Cryo-Scientific division expects INR50-60 crores annual orders from ITER for next 5+ years
items.quote: So on an average, going forward, at least INR50 crores to INR60 crores we should get on a regular basis for next at least 5 years.

items.statement: LNG division expected to grow faster than company average due to clean fuel advantage and storage demand
items.quote: Yes. This division has a good potential to grow because of several things, especially the prices of LNG, even though the diesel prices and the petrol prices we're expecting a rise, the LNG price will also rise, but the ratios will remain the same. And LNG being a clean fuel and almost advantage of 15% to 20%, this LNG division is going to grow faster than our standard products.

items.statement: Cochin Shipyard order for 6 LNG tanks of 800 cubic meters worth INR85 crores, execution over 2-3 years
items.quote: Yes. We got 6 tanks order for the 6 ships of around 800 cubic meter tank. The order value is around INR85 crores, and we have to complete between 2 to 3 years.

items.statement: Bahamas Mini LNG Terminal order of INR240 crores, INR160 crores supplied in FY26, balance in FY27
items.quote: So we had initial order of around INR230 crores to INR235 crores, and we got some additional order because of some changes. So the total order value was around INR240 crores. We have supplied around INR160 crores in this year. The balance will be supplied in FY '27.

items.statement: Beverage keg volume grew 31% to 61,000 units in FY26; secured approvals from Heineken, AB InBev, Molson Coors (40%+ global beer market)
items.quote: During the FY 2025-26, we recorded 31% increase in keg dispatch over the previous year, reflecting continued market expansion and strong demand momentum. We have now secured approvals and active orders from 3 of the world's leading global breweries, namely Heineken, AB InBev and Molson Coors, collectively representing more than 40% of the global beer market volumes.

items.statement: Chinese LNG tank imports not a risk due to PESO regulations and INOX's service network advantage
items.quote: No. See, there are some, initially, some tanks had come to India. I do agree with you. But going forward, there is a regulation in India called as a PESO, which governs the incoming flow of such tanks. And there is no shop in China, which is approved by PESO as of today.

items.statement: Data center liquid nitrogen cooling MoU with European OEM in early R&D stage; meaningful development expected in 6-12 months
items.quote: I'm happy to share that we have signed an MoU with European company to jointly develop liquid nitrogen-based cooling solution for the data center. This is currently an early-stage R&D led initiative and we expect meaningful development over the next 6 to 12 months.

items.statement: Management declined to provide FY27 revenue or profit guidance due to recent gold duty changes and PM appeal uncertainty
items.quote: I think in the scenarios like this, we would really not give out the guidance for this year. Not that we are not optimistic for it or anything, but let us reserve this guidance.

items.statement: Surat and Rajkot large-format stores targeting Q2 FY27 opening; two mid-format stores in Gandhinagar and Maninagar also planned this calendar year
items.quote: Both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

items.statement: Each new large-format store requires INR125-150 crore inventory; funding via debt, internal stock transfer and profits — no equity dilution planned
items.quote: We anticipate about INR125 crores to INR150 crores of inventory for each store.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 233 bps to 14.44%; Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin 11.19% (+63 bps YoY)
items.quote: EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

items.statement: Retail gross margin ~12-14%; Wholesale ~7-8%; Job work ~6-8%; B2B vs B2C OPM difference ~3%
items.quote: Retail would be around 12% or 14% GP. Wholesale will be around 7% to 8% GP. B2B will be around 6% to 7% and 8% GP.

items.statement: Inventory carried at 20-25% below current gold price; exploring Gold Metal Loan (GML) for new store inventory
items.quote: We have our weighted inventory at about 20% to 25% lower than the current market price.

items.statement: April 2025 sales very good; consumer demand steady in occasion wear ahead of wedding season; daily wear may pause but occasion wear resilient
items.quote: April has been very good.

items.statement: Recent customs duty hike and PM appeal to defer gold buying — impact uncertain; management monitoring ground-level consumer reaction for 1-2 months
items.quote: Certainly, I think these restrictions are not advantageous, but up to what level there is an impact is crucial.

items.statement: Targeting peak debt/equity of 1:1.2 to 1:1.5 for FY27; current equity ~INR300 cr; no equity dilution for store expansion
items.quote: We want to keep the debt levels at 1:1 ratio ideally or 1:1 point, maybe leverage to 1.4, 1.5.

items.statement: Total value of merchandise sold FY26: INR1,251 cr (Retail INR408 cr, B2B INR843 cr); job work volume down but value up due to gold price
items.quote: The total amount of value of merchandise this year that we have sold is INR1,251 crores.

items.statement: Manufacturing capacity utilization ~50-55%; no manufacturing capex needed for 2-3 years as gold price rise boosts rupee capacity
items.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

items.statement: Trade receivables spike to INR56 cr due to IIJS Bangalore exhibition and early Akshay Tritiya; now normalized to ~30-day wholesale cycle
items.quote: 24th of March, there was an exhibition in Bangalore, IIJS Tritiya. And, of course, because of exhibitions, there was a spike in sales.

items.statement: Reaffirmed FY28 organic revenue guidance of US$400 million with around 40% EBITDA margin
items.quote: we're also using the opportunity today to reaffirm our long-term guidance of FY '28, which is a US$400 million of organic revenue with around 40% of EBITDA margins.

items.statement: Reiterated FY28 guidance of US$400 million revenue and 40% EBITDA margin
items.quote: we are confident of a strong FY '27 and also reiterate our FY '28 guidance of US$ 400 million revenue and 40% EBITDA margin.

items.statement: US$100 million capex for new DDC line installed and undergoing qualification, available for commercialization next quarter
items.quote: as a part of the US$ 100 million capex which we are doing, the new line which has been installed already a couple of months back is currently undergoing qualification and will be due for availability for commercialization in the next quarter.

items.statement: Second DDC line at site undergoing engineering and qualification trials, expected available in Q2 FY27
items.quote: Our second line is now at site and is going engineering and qualification trials, and we expect that capacity to be available to us in Q2, in time with increasing demands for the product from emerging markets.

items.statement: Robust demand visibility for Semaglutide across India, Canada, and emerging markets with commercial ramp-up throughout FY27
items.quote: we see a really strong visibility on the commercial ramp-up throughout FY '27.

items.statement: Demand-supply gap for Semaglutide expected to persist for at least next 2 years with robust demand
items.quote: the demand-supply gap will continue to be there at least for next 2 years.

items.statement: Biologics funnel expanded 4x YoY with European biosimilar partner, US biosimilar major, and second project from top-3 global animal health company added
items.quote: In fact, in this year, we have expanded the funnel almost 4x versus previous year. And during the year, we saw a European biosimilar partner getting added, a US biosimilar major coming on board, and we also secured the second project from one of the top three global animal health companies.

items.statement: Biologics commercial manufacturing expected FY29 onwards with meaningful contribution in FY28
items.quote: the real kicker is once the commercial manufacturing starts for biologics, which is I would say still beyond the current time horizon which we are looking at FY28. We see the commercial manufacturing happening '29 onwards. However, the contribution from biologics will already be meaningful in FY28.

items.statement: Q4 EBITDA INR919 million, up over 5x sequentially with margin expanding 1,550 bps QoQ on higher CSA revenues
items.value: INR919 million EBITDA, 1,550 bps margin expansion
items.quote: the Q4 EBITDA reported was INR919 million, which is more than 5x sequentially and the margin expanding by 1,550 basis points quarter-over-quarter, reflecting a strong operating leverage on our higher CSA revenues.

items.statement: Targeting 50%+ ROCE in medium term
items.quote: we believe we've got a very good foundation in place and very excited about what lies ahead for us in FY '27 and '28. We expect to scale meaningfully, building towards the 50% plus ROCE expectation that we have for ourselves during the medium term.

items.statement: Deferred Steriscience/Brooks injectables acquisition due to valuation concerns from smaller shareholders; will re-evaluate in ~2 years
items.quote: we decided that it's best that we defer this transaction until such time both OneSource delivers on its US$400 million 160 and the incoming assets deliver on its US$40 million of EBITDA. And then we'll continue to look at opportunities independently to see how we can progress the business beyond the US$400 million and the US$160 million guidance. And I think in all, it's in the best interest that

items.statement: Completed 49 regulatory and customer audits in FY26 including surprise FDA inspections at two sites with EIRs received
items.quote: We saw the year successfully completing 49 regulatory and customer audits, and these include who's who. In fact, we had surprise FDA inspection during the year at two of our sites, and we completed both successfully getting the EIRs.

items.statement: Renewed EU GMP certification at flagship and sterile injectable sites; received ANVISA approval for Brazil supply
items.quote: We have renewed our EU GMP certification both at our flagship site as well as our sterile injectable site. We had ANVISA approval coming through the year, which gives us -- which puts us in pole position to supply to Brazil as our customers as they start getting approval.

items.statement: Added ~400 people at flagship site to support growth; expanded front-end US, operations, and quality teams
items.quote: We have our flagship site where thanks to all the expansion project, we have added almost 400 people, which is where the bulk of our growth is going to be coming. We have also expanded and deepened the strength of our other organization, whether it is in front-end in the US or whether it is in operations and in quality, just so that we are very well positioned on our FY '27 and '28.

items.statement: Cost of borrowing trending below 9%, down 210 bps YoY after four notch upgrades since listing
items.quote: we've had four notch upgrades during the course of this year ever since we got listed last year. And these four notch upgrades are helping us repeatedly take our overall cost of borrowing down. We are trending below 9% today, which is 210 bps lower than what it was in the prior year.

items.statement: Capacity expansion fully funded through incremental domestic and international borrowings
items.quote: All our capacity expansions that Arun and Neeraj talked about are fully funded through incremental borrowings, both from domestic and international banking relationships that we have.

items.statement: Management remains optimistic and positive about FY27 despite macro uncertainty
items.quote: So, at this stage, whilst it's very difficult to speculate, we remain optimistic and positive about this year also.

items.statement: Private brand discount vs market leaders will be maintained at least at current 40% level
items.quote: So currently, if there is a price discount of 40% vis-a-vis the leader brand, even if we have to tinker with pricing, we will ensure that the discount will at least be 40%, and if possible, obviously, it will be our endeavour to make it more.

items.statement: Fabric prices are currently rising at 10-11% due to input cost inflation
items.quote: So, the fabric prices are goin g up at about 10% to 11%. And yes, that is what we are experiencing every day now, at this moment

items.statement: Store expansion will not slow down despite macro challenges
items.quote: We will continue. We will not slow down our expansion at all because we are very excited about the long-term consumption story in this country and it is our hope and belief that these issues are not permanent in nature and they will go away.

items.statement: Rental escalations are contractual at ~5% annually, providing operating leverage with double-digit SSSG
items.quote: And our contractual arrangement is about 15% increase every 3 years, which translates into, let's say, 5% every year. And if we continue to have strong double-digit same-store sales growth, that should result into an operating leverage.

items.statement: Q4 SSSG of 13.2% driven by consumption uptick from tax/GST changes and increased growth investment
items.quote: If you would recall, in the last quarter also we had said that we are optimistic that the impact of the income tax rationalization and the reduction in GST rates would be positive for consumption. And indeed, that started playing out. So that was heartening to see. I must also mention that we have invested more in the quarter, as you would see, in growth.

items.statement: Private brands contribution improved 100bps to 74.1% of revenue in FY26
items.quote: Our private brands contribute 74.1% to our revenue in full year '26, which is a 100-bps improvement year-on-year.

items.statement: New stores in Kerala performing better than average; Gujarat and Maharashtra consistent with national network
items.quote: I would confirm to you that Kerala has been better than average and Gujarat and Maharashtra have been totally consistent with our performance nationally for the network.

items.statement: Small format stores deliver same revenue per sq ft and ROCE as large format stores
items.quote: Specifically, I can confirm to you that the small format stores, which are going deeper, they are delivering the same level of store EBITDA. And their revenue per square foot, not the absolute, per square foot is also similar to our stores in larger towns. And finally, our return on capital employed is also similar.

items.statement: Greater sensitivity to poor harvest as it directly impacts mass market consumer incomes
items.quote: I would believe that we would have greater sensitivity to that, because that is going to directly impact the incomes of mass market consumers, well to the extent that they are dependent on agriculture.

items.statement: Price increases applied selectively - not on opening price points, more flexible on high fashion price points
items.quote: We would never tinker with the opening price points and the lower price points in these difficult t imes, because those are the customers who are the most vulnerable in inflationary situations. Equally, we would be slightly more relaxed about the higher or very high fashion price points, because those are not commoditized

items.statement: 11% FY26 SSSG comprised 7% from new customers, 2% from existing customers buying more, 2% from premiumization
items.quote: So of that 11%, 7% has come because of new customers and new transactions in our store. 2% has come because our existing customers have bought more number of things. And the balance 2% has come because our customers have bought a higher price point.

items.statement: Marketing campaign achieved 1.6 billion Instagram views, among top 10 campaigns ever
items.quote: Our new campaign has now been seen 1.6 billion times on Instagram, which makes it among top 10 campaigns on Instagram ever.

items.statement: Fashionable price points grew fastest at 14.7% SSSG in Q4 vs 11.1% entry and 13.6% mid-price
items.quote: in quarter 4, our entry price point merchandise grew at 11.1% same-store sales growth, our mid -price apparel merchandise grew at 13.6% same-store sales growth, and our fashionable pric e point, which is typically the highest 2 or 3 price points, grew at 14.7

items.statement: Vendor challenges from gas availability and labor shortages are improving as vendors shift energy sources
items.quote: These challenges were firstly because of the gas availability, the commercial gas availability. And therefore, there are several small-scale factories which were struggling and so on and so forth. Secondly, again, the more small and medium-scale industries faced challenges because of labor availability.

items.statement: Exploring new formats to access more consumers, but at early stage with no specific outcome yet
items.quote: But I can confirm that we are looking at , if there is an opportunity for some different formats, which will help us get to more consumers and customers in the country. It's at a very early stage, so I would not be able to provide any colo ur to that, but I can assure you that that's very, very active

items.statement: Expects 40-42% CAGR for next 4-5 years minimum, building on 38-40% historical CAGR
items.quote: I feel that this growth momentum should continue next five, six years, and we should be able to grow at around 40%, 42% for next four or five years minimum.

items.statement: Targets INR360-400 crore revenue for FY27
items.quote: Between INR360 crores to INR400 crores is our target to invoice this year.

items.statement: Expects to maintain 24-25% EBITDA margin in FY27, with expansion from FY28 as greenfield ramps
items.quote: This year also we should be able to maintain around 24%, 25% EBITDA. This year we will be increasing some expenses on the new factory also. But from next year onwards, we will see gradual increase in the profitability.

items.statement: Order book at INR400+ crore as of March 31, 2026, providing 1-2 year visibility
items.quote: As on 31st March 2026, our order book stood at over INR400 crores, INR400 crores plus, providing healthy execution visibility over the next one to two years.

items.statement: Greenfield to add 5,000-7,000 units annual capacity for high-value RIP/RIS products up to 550 kV
items.quote: The new facility is expected to add approximately 5,000 to 7,000 units of annual capacity, focused on high-value RIP, RIS products with gradual ramp-up over the next few years.

items.statement: Plans fundraise of INR100-110 crore (approved up to INR150 crore) for 550 kV testing, brownfield expansion, and working capital
items.quote: Around INR100 to INR110 is what we are eyeing. And that will be mainly for the capex for the increased production range up till 550 kV and the testing infrastructure.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 260 bps to 25.7% driven by scale, price recovery, supplier negotiation, currency hedging, and export/retrofit mix
items.quote: EBITDA margins stood at 25.7% compared to 23.1% in FY25, a growth of almost 260 basis points. This reflects our continuous focus on maintaining margin discipline even during a phase of accelerated growth.

items.statement: Has pass-through arrangements with customers for commodity, currency, and input cost escalations
items.quote: There is an arrangement with the customer that we would also be transferring that price rise to them. And they are able to give it to us.

items.statement: Customers giving 24-36 month blanket orders; demand strong across OIP, RIP, and high-current segments
items.quote: Today the situation is the transformer companies are giving us blanket orders for the next 24 to 36 months and they want us to prepare our side for those all delivery execution.

items.statement: Sukrut Electric acquired; targets INR150-160 crore revenue in 4-5 years (5-6x from INR25-26 crore in FY26)
items.quote: Sukrut, we assume that in next four to five years, we should be able to cross at least INR150 to INR160 crores of revenue. And presently it is around INR25 crores, INR26 crores revenue financial year '26.

items.statement: Export target: 20%+ of revenue in 2-3 years; USA subsidiary operational, EU/UK partnerships active, customers awaiting greenfield readiness
items.quote: Our target would be that eventually in next two to three years, we at least do 20% plus from exports.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth guided at 30-40% and PAT growth at 50-60%
items.quote: For FY27, our initial outlook indicates revenue growth of approximately 30% to 40% and PAT growth of about 50% to 60%.

items.statement: Blended EBITDA margin guided at 29-31% for FY27
items.quote: I feel blended where we have guided 29% to 31% of the EBITDA margin, which will probably will see in in coming quarters as Apnar will start giving us about the revenue that we anticipate

items.statement: Emerging markets EBITDA margin at 18-19% in Q4, expected to sustain at 18-21% in FY27
items.quote: Q4 EBITDA, which was notably 18% to 19%, we think, will continue to be the EBITDA percentage for our emerging market business going forward.

items.statement: Apnar acquisition suppressed blended margin by ~100 bps in Q4; margin to improve as Apnar revenue ramps
items.quote: I think they're about 100 basis point being suppressed because of the acquisition of Apnar where we've incurred the expenses over last three months, but the subsequent revenue has not come in as of as of last quarter.

items.statement: Emerging markets revenue projected at INR180 crores in FY27; 4,000+ products under registration
items.quote: In the emerging market, we anticipate that next year our projection is about INR180 crores of revenue that we are looking to get from emerging markets.

items.statement: Regulated markets 83% YoY growth in FY26; CDMO-CMO ~47-48% of revenue, own products ~50-53%
items.quote: I think CDMO and own product are almost the same, which we continue continue to do around 50% to 53% of our own product, and 47%, 48% of CDMO-CMO taken together.

items.statement: Guidance kept conservative due to external uncertainties: shipping lines, US inflationary pressures, geopolitical factors
items.quote: As we speak, there are a lot of moving parts in terms of external environment, which is not very conducive, shipping lines, everything, overall atmosphere, even in US in terms of inflationary pressures, etcetera.

items.statement: INR100 crores unutilized IPO funds to be deployed for sterile manufacturing development over next couple of years
items.quote: So that INR100-odd crores of IPO fund is for a specific purpose that is already been given in our DRHP. So, we plan to start the operations for that particular purpose within this year.

items.statement: Apnar Pharma revenue expected INR80-100 crores in FY27, INR180-200 crores in 2-3 years
