items.quote: We have an order intake this year of INR 3,714 crores versus INR 3,100 crores in the previous year. Our opening backlog on April 1st is also up by about 34%, which gives us a strong revenue visibility as well.

items.statement: Targeting 15% consolidated EBITDA margin in medium term, up from current 11.5%
items.quote: So, our company of us, in engineering, we believe that a 15% EBITDA margin, if you look at some of our peers, that should be something that we should definitely aspire to. So, we are today at 11.5%, 11.4%, and we believe that in the medium term, that is a number, at least as a minimum, that we should achieve, if not more, right.

items.statement: Poland facility at full capacity; need to build two more sheds; Vatva heavy engineering facility can target INR 700-800 crores revenue with small investment
items.quote: It is full. It is completely full. We need to build another two sheds as soon as possible.

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions and Middle East conflict create uncertainty; cautious on guidance timing
items.quote: However, as already mentioned in prior calls, there are also still some territories which are impacted by the on going crises due to the now new Middle East conflict, and the general geopolitical tensions, uncertainties. So, we are confident, but we also do not want to be too bullish.

items.statement: No formal FY27 guidance given; management preparing three-year plan to share in coming quarters
items.quote: We have outlined some basic three -year plans and we are in a good position to come to the market in the next few quarters. Again, we would like to come when we have a little bit more confidence around just the general business environment, but we have something in place now that will at least give us some visibility and vision for the next few years.

items.statement: German restructuring to deliver INR 45 crores annual cost savings; full impact as people retire during year
items.quote: In fact, we would like to share that we saved with this initiative INR 45 crores on an annual basis.

items.statement: Plan to repay USD 20 million debt in FY27; restructuring of financing and Luxembourg entity ongoing
items.quote: We will repay or intend to repay easily 20 million USD… Tarak Patel: From the international. Alexander Poempner: From the group, to reduce the cash and reduce also the debt position. This could be easily done

items.statement: Nearly 50% of order intake from non-traditional industries (semiconductors, defense, oil & gas, petrochemicals, metals & minerals)
items.quote: Nearly 50% of our order intake this year has come from non -traditional industries. So, when I say non -traditional, these are non -chemical and non -pharma. So, our diversification strategy into these new industries has given us a lot of additional order intake as well.

items.statement: Gas and metal cost increases impacted margins but have now stabilized; some long-term contracts have escalation clauses above 5% threshold
items.quote: Number two is that we probably had a little bit of increases in some of our costs, which were a result of the gas prices going up and metal prices and stuff like that. But that has now stabilized, so we should be okay.

items.statement: Free cash flow INR 367 crores, up INR 49 crores YoY; FCF/EBITDA >90%; net debt/adj EBITDA 0.4x vs 0.5x prior year
items.quote: We were able to achieve an improvement versus the half year, which I think we also already estimated in the last call, so we were able to achieve this. And therefore, we gener ated a strong free cash flow of INR 367 crores, which is even slightly upper than prior year by INR 49 crores. And our free cash flow to EBITDA ratio remained slightly above 90%.

items.statement: Repaid INR 60 crores long-term debt during the year
items.quote: We have repaid our long -term debt of INR 60 crores during this year and therefore, with also the strong cash generation that we achieved in this year, we reduced our net debt to adjusted EBITDA ratio to 0.4x versus 0.5x in the previous year

items.statement: Expects double-digit topline growth next year on higher BOPP/CPP utilization and new businesses.
items.quote: The Company expects double-digit topline growth next year mainly due to enhanced utilization of BOPP and CPP capacity added in FY25-26.

items.statement: CAPEX cycle largely complete; focus on sweating ₹1,200 Cr strategic CAPEX done in last 3 years.
items.quote: CAPEX cycle of the Company is largely complete. Focus will be on sweating strategic CAPEX done in last 3 years (₹1,200 Cr.).

items.statement: Net debt reduced by ₹75 crores in last 6 months to ₹1,159 crores; roadmap to reduce over next 2 years.
items.quote: There is clear roadmap to reduce net debt over next 2 years. In this direction, the Company has reduced net debt by Rs 75 crores during last 6 months to Rs 1,159 cr. (2.4 times to EBITDA and 0.7 times to equity)

items.statement: BOPP margin was ₹20/kg in Q4 vs ₹13/kg in Dec-25 quarter and ₹20/kg in Mar-25 quarter.
items.quote: BOPP margin was running at Rs 20/- per kg in Q4 vs Rs 13 per kg in Dec-25 quarter and Rs 20/- March-25 quarter,

items.statement: BOPET margin was ₹18/kg in Q4 vs ₹12/kg in Dec-25 quarter and ₹18/kg in Mar-25 quarter.
items.quote: BOPET margin was running at Rs 18/- per kg in Q4 vs Rs 12/- per kg in Dec-25 quarter & Rs 18/- per kg in March-25 quarter

items.statement: Indian flexible packaging volumes growing 8%-10%; tracking incremental share through Speciality positioning.
items.quote: On the demand side, Indian flexible packaging volumes are growing 8%-10%. We are tracking incremental share through Speciality positioning.

items.statement: Speciality Films are 60% of films and growing, insulating blended margins.
items.quote: Speciality Films are 60% of our films and are growing, which insulates blended margins.

items.statement: Industry margins for BOPET and BOPP may remain volatile as new capacity comes.
items.quote: Industry margins for BOPET and BOPP may remain volatile in the current year as new capacity comes.

items.statement: US business expected to grow 15-20% minimum; winning new customers.
items.quote: We should see anywhere between 15 to 20% growth as a minimum in US business.

items.statement: Plastech expected high single-digit EBITDA in FY27, mid-teens in FY28.
items.quote: You see, in FY27, Plastech business should start making high single-digit EBITDA, while in FY28, we expect it to be high or mid-teens EBITDA numbers.

items.statement: Cosmo Consumer to continue losses in current year; at least couple of years to be profitable; targeting ₹100 crores revenue.
items.quote: Cosmo Consumer will continue to make losses in the current financial year, for the simple reason that we will continue to be aggressive in building our brand. I feel that Cosmo Consumer will take at least couple of years to be profitable. First thing is to reach INR 100 crores benchmark at the earliest.

items.statement: Confident of more than 50% CAGR in Cosmo Consumer business.
items.quote: So, we are confident of the 50% CAGR itself in Cosmo Consumer as a minimum.

items.statement: Debt to be brought below 2x EBITDA within 12-18 months; CAPEX next year less than ₹100 crores.
items.quote: Given that next year the CAPEX is expected to be less than INR 100 crores. We should be able to decrease our debt even by a higher amount this year. And this will continue in FY28, the outlook is to reduce the debt even further. So, we are already at 2.4x to EBITDA in terms of debt. And we will bring it below within ne

items.statement: ROCE expected to be 14-15% next year, up from 11% in FY26.
items.quote: For FY26, it is 11%, and next year we expect it to be around 14% to 15% in the coming years, and this will continue to go up as we ramp up our capacity utilization and grow in new businesses.

items.statement: Strong merchant export order pipeline expected to convert into healthy performance this quarter.
items.quote: With merchant exports, we are seeing strong order pipeline and that should turn into a healthy performance during this quarter.

items.statement: Export demand for acrylamide picking up in second half of current quarter, augurs well for sales.
items.quote: So, the export demand has started to pick up in the second half of the current quarter and that augurs well for our overall sales for acrylamide.

items.statement: NMA volumes expected to remain stable; remains a key growth driver for manufacturing.
items.quote: Regarding N-methylol acrylamide, (NMA) volumes are expected to remain stable.

items.statement: PAM solid project advanced to piloting; commercialization activities hoped to start this year.
items.quote: The PAM solid project has advanced to the piloting, and we are progressing the project as planned. And we hope to start commercialization activities during this year going forward.

items.statement: Specialty amines project with Koei Chemicals progressing as planned; decision expected during current year.
items.quote: The Specialty amines project, which is being undertaken along with Koei Chemicals Company, that is also progressing as planned , and we hope to take a decision on the project going forward during the current year.

items.statement: EBITDA in absolute numbers should be sustainable; margin percentage driven by chemical prices, expected to remain healthy.
items.quote: The EBITDA in terms of absolute numbers, again, should be sustainable. However, in terms of margin percentage, as I mentioned, it is driven by price.

items.statement: Q4 gain was a mix of operational and inventory gain; seen as sustainable as far as foreseeable.
items.quote: In terms of the question on Q4, whether it was operational gain or just inventory gain, so I would say it is a mix of both.

items.statement: Targeting increase in overall top line versus previous year at current market prices.
items.quote: So overall, we see we are targeting an increase in overall top line from the previous year at current market prices.

items.statement: Declined to give any FY27 EBITDA number; endeavor is to grow distribution and manufacturing.
items.quote: It is difficult to put down any number as an assumption because it will not hold much value.

items.statement: Permanent revocation of plant closure directions means operations can continue without interruption.
items.quote: Basically, the permanent revocation means that the closure notice which was received is now permanently revoked , in the sense , the operation can continue without any interruption.

items.statement: Revocation and capacity expansion unrelated; hopes to achieve maximum utilization for manufactured products in FY27 and FY28.
items.quote: So, Mr. Vishwendra, both these things, the revocation and the capacity expansion are not related to each other. So having said that, we hope to achieve the maximum possible utilization for our manufactured products for both the years.

items.statement: Unpredictable US tariff policies weakened offtake from US oil and gas sector, impacting merchant exports.
items.quote: The year was also marked by some external challenges in particular the unpredictable tariff policies by the Trump administration, which led to weaker offtake from the US oil and gas sector, which impacted the overall exports, overall merchant exports.

items.statement: Exited ceramic binder business in Morbi to focus on upstream acrylamide and higher value applications.
items.quote: As a part of our strategic decision, we exited from the ceramic binder business in M orbi.

items.statement: Management expects EBITDA margins to dip in the next few quarters due to ongoing investments, targeting a return to 13-14% margins once investments yield results.
items.quote: So, there will be a dip in the EBITDA margin. Our expectation is once these investments are done and then once we start seeing the results out of these investments, we should get back to our -- the earlier margin of around 13%, 14%.

items.statement: Capex expansions planned over the next 2 years, particularly in cookware and appliances, with recent investment in triply facility at Karjan.
items.quote: And we do believe that in the next 2 years, we will find capex expansions happening in cookware in particular and also across the appliances as well.

items.statement: Company plans to spend close to INR 200 crores over a 3-year period starting Q4 FY25 on long-term strategy initiatives, and capital deployment of close to INR 300 crores.
items.quote: As we had indicated before, we will be spending close to around INR 200 crores in the 3-year period, which we started in Q4 of last year -- Q4 of FY '24-25'.

items.statement: Gross margin expansion in Q4 driven by internal inventory management, favorable product mix (higher appliance share), and cost reduction initiatives on manufacturing and sourcing.
items.quote: This is a combination of internal inventory management and also, in terms of, like you have mentioned, some of the categories have high gross margins, and they have picked up during the quarter as well, the product mix.

items.statement: Input cost inflation averaging around 10% with specific areas up 15%; price hikes taken mid-Q4 with impact partially in Q4 and Q1, further hikes inevitable but calibrated to demand.
items.quote: So, at an average, we would say it's around 10%. We've seen increases in specific areas of around 15% as well. Post-war scenario, there is a definitive increase of close to around 10%.

items.statement: Domestic market grew 14.4% in Q4; appliances grew 20% driven by induction cooktop demand surge from geopolitical volatility, kitchenware grew 10%; underlying demand robust across categories.
items.quote: From a TTK Prestige perspective, we had a quarter 4 growth of around 14.4% for the domestic market.

items.statement: Cookware growth driven by new material innovations (stainless steel, triply, cast iron, ceramic) growing at 20%+ industry-wide; all cooker portfolio now induction-based; industry cooker mix 50-55% stainless steel.
items.quote: Yes. These categories are growing at 20% plus.

items.statement: Exports constrained by supply chain disruptions despite order-related demand; domestic growth strong at 14.4%, company-level growth 12.5% in Q4.
items.quote: We had a little bit of a setback on the exports , given the scenario of a disrupted supply chain, while we did have supply-related or order -related demand generation, but we were constrained by the supply chain issues.

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, and rising raw material prices continue to weigh on the industry for the next few quarters.
items.quote: Overhang of some of these challenges continues to be there for the next few quarters.

items.statement: Prestige Exclusive stores contribute 12-15% of business, growing in double digits; network at 700+ stores with continued expansion across India.
items.quote: At a business level, it contributes close to around 12% to 15% of our business and continues to be growing robustly in double digits.

items.statement: General trade growth rebound is company-specific due to distribution initiatives; industry-level general trade still lags modern trade and e-commerce.
items.quote: I do believe that there's a little bit of a growth rebound that's happened in general trade, but I would sort of look at it -- general trade growth has been very specific to the initiatives that we have taken at a company level.

items.statement: Kitchenware manufacturing operating at 85%+ utilization; appliances at 75-80%; capacity expansions underway based on volume projections.
items.quote: The kitchenware would probably be operating at 85% plus; the appliances operate similarly at around 75% to 80%.

items.statement: Advertising spend typically 5-6% of revenue; no specific guidance given for FY27 budget.
items.quote: Normally, we spend anywhere between a 5% to 6%. That is the number that we normally spend.

items.statement: Channel inventory normalized; no significant GST-related channel filling impact in Q4 performance.
items.quote: The channel inventory is normalized. Not much of impact because of GST in the Q4 performance as well.

items.statement: Judge brand P&L too early to comment; managed independently with separate P&L structure targeting mass segment in Tier 2/3 towns.
items.quote: So, I think it will be too early for us to comment on that at this point of time. Over a period of time, we definitely believe that Judge as a brand would have its independent standing in terms of P&L as well.

items.statement: Expect mid- to high-teen revenue growth and EBITDA margin of 14% to 14.5% for FY27
items.quote: We expect 15% growth in top line. It may be more or 1%, 2% more or less. And for EBITDA margin, we expect 14%.

items.statement: Targeting INR2,700 crores revenue in FY27 with 15% annual top-line growth thereafter
items.quote: We have already discussed that we are targeting around INR2,700 crores in the next FY 2027. And we are expecting around 15% annual growth for top line every year on the existing level.

items.statement: FY26 capex of INR160 crores funded entirely through internal accruals
items.quote: During financial year 2026, the company incurred capex of around INR160 crores towards capacity expansion, operational improvements and infra enhancement, and were funded entirely through internal accruals, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

items.statement: Greenfield project on new 100-acre land estimated at INR1,200-1,400 crores over 4-5 years, annual spend INR200-250 crores
items.quote: Broad mind set is around INR1,200 crores to INR1,400 crore.

items.statement: FY27 capex planned at INR200-250 crores, split 60% growth and 40% infra/automation, largely for pharmaceuticals
items.quote: It is a mix of both, both for growth and infra developments and efficiency improvements. So generally, we are doing 60% growth and 40% for development of infra and automation and land procurement. So generally 60% on growth activities.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin improved 251 bps to 15.2%; full-year FY26 margin 12.4% vs 10.7% prior year
items.quote: For the full year of financial year 2026, EBITDA increased by around 29% to INR290 crore, with margin improving to 12.4% from 10.7% in the previous year.

items.statement: Management expects blended EBITDA margin of 14% to 14.5% for FY27
items.quote: And the EBITDA is something around, like Pardeepji just said in the previous question, around 14% to 14.5%.

items.statement: Ibuprofen demand stabilized from Oct 2025 after destocking; expected to maintain for 4-6 quarters
items.quote: And we were expecting these demand of especially ibuprofen from October 2025 onwards, and that has happened. And we anticipate that this level will maintain upcoming four to six quarters.

items.statement: Paracetamol capacity utilization to rise from 55% to 75% in FY27, reaching full utilization by FY28
items.quote: We are hopeful that we will be reaching to around 70% to 75% capacity utilization in FY 2027 itself. And I think in FY 2028, we will be having the full capacity utilization by that time.

items.statement: Non-ibuprofen APIs (Paracetamol, Metformin, Clopidogrel, Pantoprazole) showing healthy traction; launched Minoxidil, expanded Pantoprazole capacity
items.quote: Within pharmaceuticals, the non-Ibuprofen API continued to witness healthy traction with key products such as Paracetamol, Metformin, Clopidogrel, Pantoprazole and other APIs in improved demand across markets. The company further strengthened its non-Ibuprofen segment through the launch of Minoxidil and the expansion of Pantoprazole capacity to cater to growing demand.

items.statement: Non-ibuprofen export share targeted at 25% of non-ibu revenue in FY27, up from ~20% currently
items.quote: We are expecting that we should achieve around 25% in this FY 2027.

items.statement: Price increases in later part of Q4 FY26 accompanied by raw material cost increases; spreads largely unchanged as cost pass-through to customers
items.quote: Vignesh, the spread, I think, is more or less same, or might be a little bit increased because whatever the prices has been increased, the same is also being adjusted into the -- finish product. So not much, we can say that the spread is not much.

items.statement: Raw material supply disruption for one week in early March due to crude-based chemicals allocation; resolved via pro-rata supply from government refineries
items.quote: In the first week of March only, we have faced some crude-based chemical and gas, which are provided by oil marketing company, the government refineries. But within one week, they have developed some metrics where they started supplying to all the manufacturers on a certain pro rata basis.

items.statement: No buyback planned as funds prioritized for growth projects including greenfield expansion
items.quote: As of now, no, because as of now, this has not been discussed in the Board. But I think whenever this is discussed, we will -- as of now, we are focusing on the growth. If we start buying back, then growth will be impacted.

items.statement: Employee benefit expense ~9-10% of revenue; increase due to variable pay provisioning and new plant hiring
items.quote: on turnover, we are having around 10%.

items.statement: Expects 20-25% revenue growth in FY27 over previous year.
items.quote: What I can tell you on overall revenue is we are expecting about 20% to 25% growth in revenue in FY27 from the previous year.

items.statement: Targets revenue of INR1,000 crores with EBITDA margin over 18% by Vision 2029.
items.quote: We aim to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18%.

items.statement: Saudi plant capex expected at INR20-25 crores.
items.quote: The Saudi plant for us, we expect to spend approximately INR20 crores to INR25 crores.

items.statement: Pyrolysis and rCB capex approximately INR40 crores, largely completed.
items.quote: The pyro, RCB capex is approximately INR40-odd crores, and that's largely completed.

items.statement: PCMB contribution expected to rise to 8-10% of turnover in FY27 from 4%.
items.quote: We expect the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27, supported by strong business momentum.

items.statement: PCMB revenue projected at approximately INR75 crores in FY27.
items.quote: for FY '27, our projection of revenue contribution from PCMB is about INR75 crores.

items.statement: rCB and TPO plants expected to contribute INR50-55 crores top line in FY27.
items.quote: our projection for this RCB and TPO plant for the FY27 is somewhere around INR50 crores-INR55-odd crores for the FY27.

items.statement: Expects to maintain ~18% EBITDA margin achieved in Q4.
items.quote: we have achieved about 18% EBITDA in Q4. We expect to maintain that.

items.statement: Pyrolysis and rCB plants expected at 15-19% EBITDA margins.
items.quote: Our expectation is maybe 15% on the low side and 18% or 19% on the high side.

items.statement: Infra business may see reduction in Q1-Q2 FY27 due to bitumen shortage, but normalize later.
items.quote: we expect some reduction possibly in the infra business during Q1, Q2 of this year. And that is probably, it will be because of less availability of bitumen.

items.statement: Industrial segment expected to see very strong growth in FY27.
items.quote: We absolutely see very strong growth in the Industrial segment.

items.statement: Plans to finance capex mostly from internal accruals, may take up to INR20 crores debt.
items.quote: We may opt to take up to about INR20 crores of debt also, but I don't expect it to be any more than that.

items.statement: Expects 15-20% top-line growth in FY27, with at least 10% volume growth, assuming stable metal prices.
items.quote: assuming that the current metal prices levels have stayed over the year, we should be achieving some 15-20% growth in top line. That should be around minimum 10% of volume growth.

items.statement: Aims to return to pre-U.S. tariff margin levels by end of FY27.
items.quote: by end of FY27, we hope to achieve the pre-tariff, you know, pre-U.S. tariff levels of margin also.

items.statement: Narmadapuram greenfield project to invest ~INR 300 crores by FY28, operations start Q1 FY28.
items.quote: The project at Narmadapuram envisages an investment of approximately INR 300 crores by FY28, with operations expected to partly commence in Q1 FY28 and ramp up through FY28.

items.statement: Targets INR 500 crores sales from Narmadapuram in FY28, scaling to INR 1,200 crores in FY29.
items.quote: We are targeting sales of approximately INR 500 crores from Narmadapuram in FY28, which will scale up to INR 1,200 crores in FY29.

items.statement: Narmadapuram plant margins expected at 9-10%.
items.quote: And margin from this Narmadapuram plant are expected to be between 9-10%.

items.statement: Aims to achieve INR 5,000 crores revenue by FY31, doubling sales every 3-4 years.
items.quote: we will begin to achieve the revenue milestone of INR 5,000 crores in the next five years, that is by FY31, which shall mean that we will be having to double our sales every three to four years.

items.statement: Order book as of March 31, 2026: INR 583 crores total, INR 508 crores domestic, INR 76 crores exports.
items.quote: Our order book as of 31st March 2026 stood at INR 583 crores, comprising INR 508 crores of domestic orders and INR 76 crores of exports.

items.statement: Expects strong U.S. demand recovery from Q2 FY27 onwards.
items.quote: we are expecting that Q2 onwards, actually, we should be seeing a very good demand pull out of the U.S.

items.statement: Policy to avoid firm-price orders beyond 3-4 months to mitigate metal price volatility.
items.quote: Paramount continues to follow a deliberate policy of not accepting firm-price orders with delivery horizon beyond three to four months, a discipline that protects our margins from copper and aluminum price volatility.

items.statement: Narmadapuram to focus on EHV cables up to 132 kV, specialized conductors, and elastomeric cables.
items.quote: The product focus for Narmadapuram will be extra high voltage cables up to 132 kV, specialized conductors and cables for the transmission sector, elastomeric EBeam cables, and EPR cables, etc., EPR, lead-sheathed rubber cables.

items.statement: U.S. tariffs caused significant disruption in FY26, but recovery expected.
items.quote: Such huge increases in U.S. tariffs over a very short period of time, without any notice at all, caused a significant disruption for our export business in FY26.

items.statement: Equity raise of INR 122 crores for Narmadapuram project, with promoters contributing INR 30 crores.
items.quote: Out of the overall project of INR 300 crores, around INR 122 crores out of this INR 30 crore, of course, the promoters we ourselves are putting in, INR 92 crores all is coming from investors.

items.statement: Targets double-digit margins within 3-4 years.
items.quote: we are looking at double-digit margins within the next three to four years at the minimum.

items.statement: With Phase 1 and existing capacity, peak revenue potential of INR 3,600-4,000 crores.
items.quote: from the Phase 1, I think from Phase 1, we should be able to touch around INR 3600-4000 crores.

items.statement: Thousand crore turnover target is for 2030, not FY27.
items.quote: This is in terms of numbers the thousand crore is not for the next financial year. It is the target of 2030 for which we are gearing up in terms of capacity expansion in powder as well as egg production.

items.statement: 400 crore capex to expand layer birds from 20 lakh to 40 lakh by 2029.
items.quote: This 48,4400-crore investment where currently we are at 20 lakh birds and by 2029 we will be at 40 lakh birds.

items.statement: Plan to increase egg powder capacity from 7,000 to 10,000 tons over five years.
items.quote: We are looking to do 10,000 tons. The capex is analyzed be able to give a better picture by end of next quarter or after that. But definitely there is plan to invest to enhance our capacity to about 10,000 tons and when we will realize this is the next question. Maybe you can take five years’ time to achieve some 7,000

items.statement: Capex to add at least 50 paisa per egg gross margin by replacing market purchases.
items.quote: There is a gross margin of at least 50 paisa market price and oil production at this stage.

items.statement: Average realization is about 722 on powder terms, expected to continue next quarter.
items.quote: So, our average realization is about 722. This is on powder terms which I expect to continue for the coming quarter because the international market situation there are some changes, but it is not going to affect us very hugely.

items.statement: FY27 capacity fully utilized, no big increase in powder top line expected.
items.quote: So, for 26 - 27 we don't foresee a very big increase in capacity.

items.statement: Q4 realization dip due to product mix, not a concern.
items.quote: So, quarter four was a slight dip, but it's because of the product mix that goes on.

items.statement: Bird flu is the biggest disruptor, causing supply fluctuations and price volatility.
items.quote: Price trend Bird flu so bird flu is the biggest disruptor in our industry.

items.statement: Acquiring remaining 74% of SKM Universal for 27.75 crores, total valuation 37 crores.
items.quote: I think the valuation number that is about 37 crores for the entire company. Since our company already holds 26%, the 74% is 27.75 crores is the out pay that will go.

items.statement: Japan branch expected by July end, will increase market share.
items.quote: Japan is under the establishment hopefully within two to three months we will have our Japan branch by July end of something.

items.statement: Realize at least 5% more than competition in key markets due to quality and reputation.
items.quote: I can tell you we realize at least 5% more than our competition in these markets.

items.statement: Forex hedging: currently 30% covered, usually 70% covered, due to high volatility.
items.quote: We are currently at 30% coverage because of the high volatility we see now. So, we have not done the 70%. We have gone down. We have kept the open 70% and 30% covered.

items.statement: Contracts: 70-75% on contractual basis, 20-30% spot, typically 3-6 months.
items.quote: And about 70% of our business, 75% of our business is on contractual basis. About 20, 30% is on spot basis.

items.statement: New value-added Egg Pro drink reformulated, launching this week from June.
items.quote: We have already reformulated our Egg Pro drink which will be put into market this week from June.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth expected 9-11% with EBITDA margin improvement of 50-100 bps.
items.quote: Looking ahead to FY '27, we remain confident in our growth trajectory and currently expect revenue growth of 9% to 11%, along with an improvement in EBITDA margin of 50 to 100 basis points.

items.statement: Margin improvement to come from gross margin and employee cost, targeting peak 15% gradually.
items.quote: we have guided 50 to 100 basis point year-over-year improvement next year, we have given a guidance.

items.statement: Digital mix on track to reach 50% by end of FY27.
items.quote: We remain on track to reach 50% digital mix towards the end of FY '27.

items.statement: Lifestyle products currently 35% of sales, targeting 50% medium-term.
items.quote: Our product mix, lifestyle products now contribute around 35% of total sales, and we continue to target a medium -term share of 50%.

items.statement: Lab-grown diamonds contribute 11% of retail revenue at average selling price ~$250.
items.quote: Lab- grown diamonds are another important new lever. LGD now contributes 11% of retail revenue at an average selling price of around USD 250.

items.statement: Germany achieved EBITDA breakeven in FY26, expected to contribute to group profitability from FY27.
items.quote: Germany is now well placed to contribute to group profitability from FY '27 onwards.

items.statement: Tax rate expected to be steady around 22% for upcoming years.
items.quote: So our tax rate will be steady around 22% for the upcoming years.

items.statement: TV broadcasting and content costs to remain around 20% of revenue.
items.quote: We expect that this will continue to be around in 20-odd percentage that line.

items.statement: Tariff uncertainty remains but company agile with multi-country operations.
items.quote: With the current administration, Mehul, we can never be certain. -- but I can only say that is whatever the circumstances, we are very agile and pretty multi-country operations and logistics that we'll deal better than competitors.

items.statement: Mindful Souls impairment of INR25 crores due to conservative testing; potential reversal if performance improves.
items.quote: But for now, because of the initial year, we haven't converted well from Mindful souls, that is why the write-off is coming INR25 crores.

items.statement: New U.K. lease signed, ROU assets increased; operational efficiencies expected from consolidating buildings.
items.quote: So ROU increase is mainly related to the new lease we have signed for the U.K. premises.

items.statement: AI integrated across marketing and operations, improving conversion and customer spend.
items.quote: So from product identification to creative angles to making the creative AI and the landing pages and analytics. Completely this is on the marketing side. Now we are also using AI in our operations to -- for the supply chain demand forecasting into the back-end supply chain analysis and optimization.

items.statement: If Naukri grows at 10% or more, margins should remain the same; if growth slows to 7-8%, margins may dip slightly in the short term.
items.quote: Now, my sense is that if we are able to grow our topline in double digits, margins should remain the same. If you're able to grow at 10% or more, you should be able to maintain margin in Naukri. If we grow faster than that, then margins could get better going forward. If we, on the other hand, if the economy slows down further and Naukri grows at 7-8%, then we may sort of lose a little bit of marg

items.statement: 99acres aims to double billings from Rs.497 crores over the next 3 years and achieve 25-30% EBITDA margin.
items.quote: Our billings last year was about Rs. 497 crores. We should aim to at least double our business, if you ask me, over the next 3 years. If we are able to do that, then we should be able to generate at least a 25-30% EBITDA margin as well.

items.statement: 99acres billings growth expected to recover in Q1 FY27 after one-time transitional impact in Q4 FY26.
items.quote: We expect billings growth to recover in Q1 once again.

items.statement: InfoEdge will continue investing in JobHai and AI, not starving these areas of investment for long-term growth.
items.quote: There are two big areas where we are still investing in our recruitment business. One is JobHai, and the other is AI. We don't want to starve these two areas of investment. We'll continue to invest in both JobHai and AI, important for us for the long term.

items.statement: AI-Rex has over 1,000 clients onboarded and 30,000 job mandates on the platform.
items.quote: With over 1,000 clients onboarded and 30,000 job mandates already on AI-Rex, early adoption is encouraging.

items.statement: Standalone operating margin was 40% in Q4 FY26 and 37% for full year FY26.
items.quote: Operating profits at a standalone level grew by 39% YOY to Rs.323 crores, and the operating margins stood at 40%.

items.statement: 99acres reduced warranty provision from 20% to 5% for cost-per-lead model, resulting in a one-time Rs.20.5 crore revenue reversal in Q4 FY26.
items.quote: Accordingly, a portion of the accumulated provision over the last 8 quarters has been reversed and revenue for the quarter as well as for the year stands increased by Rs. 20.5 crores as a result.

items.statement: Hiring sentiment remains subdued and lukewarm; larger GCCs have shrunk headcount, non-IT hiring slowed, but AI/ML roles show massive growth.
items.quote: See the overall job market, I think the sentiment continues to be subdued. It's not a hot market. It's a lukewarm market. Of course, there is hiring happening in pockets. But, for example, you mentioned GCCs, the smaller GCCs continue to hire, but the larger ones, their headcount has shrunk over the last few quarters, in some cases.

items.statement: Naukri Jobseeker Services online revenue mix rose from 27% to 53% in 15 months; paid users as % of MAU rose from 1.2% to 2.2%.
items.quote: The shift to a self -serve online-first model has driven the online revenue mix from 27% to 53% in the last 15 months, while monthly ac tive users have been growing. Paid users as a percentage of the monthly active user base have also risen from 1.2% to 2.2% over the last 15 months, with meaningful headroom ahead

items.statement: Shiksha faces persistent headwinds from AI-driven search behaviour changes reducing Google referred traffic and impacting billings.
items.quote: AI-driven changes in search behaviour have been affecting Shiksha's traffic for several quarters. In Q4, this translated into a more direct billing impact as reduced referred search traffic from Google affected client deliveries. We expect this headwind to persist over the near term.

items.statement: Study abroad segment softness in US and Canada due to evolving student preferences and macro factors; diversifying to UK, UAE, Europe.
items.quote: The study abroad segment in the education business saw softness in certain markets, particularly the US and Canada, driven by evolving student preferences and broader macro factors in these geographies. We are actively broadening our destination coverage with increased focus on the UK, UAE and Continental Europe to better align with where student demand is moving.

items.statement: JobHai monetizing aggressively in Delhi NCR after achieving traffic leadership; expanding template to Mumbai and Bangalore in FY27.
items.quote: Now that we've achieved that objective, we are monetizing aggressively or we're trying to monetize more aggressively in NCR and we're taking this template to other markets.

items.statement: 99acres launched 99Shorts in NCR for new home segment; plans to expand to other major cities in FY27.
items.quote: The recent rollout of 99Shorts in NCR aims to drive deeper engagement in this segment with expansion to other major cities planned in for FY27.

items.statement: Talent Pulse generated Rs.30-35 crores revenue in FY26; making it available to more customers to grow faster than core Naukri business.
items.quote: We did about Rs.30-35 crores last year from our Talent Pulse offering. We are making it available to more customers, so that they can try it out. We've launched new variants and again, this is a business we think we can grow much faster than the overall Naukri business.

name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd

items.statement: Standalone cash utilization plan: INR1,000 cr in FY26, INR600 cr in FY27, INR500 cr in FY28, aiming FCF positive in FY29.
items.value: INR1,000 crores in FY '26, INR600 crores in FY '27 and INR500 crores in '28
items.quote: As stated, we are planning to utilize it INR1,000 crores in FY '26, INR600 crores in FY '27 and INR500 crores in '28, post which we aim to be FCF positive in FY '29.

items.statement: FY27 capex guidance INR250-300 crores at consolidated level, no one-off GL capex.
items.quote: Next year, this one-off type of thing will not come. So, we have -- in our plan, I already conveyed roughly INR300 crores capex, INR250 crores to INR300 crores at console level.

items.statement: Raw material inflation 3-4%, may take price increases of 5-8% in H2 depending on category.
items.quote: And therefore, effectively, it would sort of put pressure in the second half of the year to take -- to fully counter it, take price increases between 5% to 8% depending on the category.

items.statement: Tasva expected to breakeven by FY28; TCNS breakeven by end FY27, profitable FY28.
items.quote: We had said FY '28, and we still feel that's the right assessment at this point as well. As far as TCNS is concerned, Jagdish in his opening remarks had talked about how the losses have halved this year versus FY '25. We're still not profitable. We'll probably towards the end of FY '27 is when we would expect to breake

items.statement: TMRW portfolio expected to become profitable by FY29.
items.quote: As far as profitability of TMRW is concerned, we had indicated FY '29 as the year in which we expect that TMRW as a portfolio level, some of all brands to become profitable.

items.statement: TMRW raised INR440 cr equity and INR500 cr NCDs, now has INR800 cr cash for growth.
items.quote: As you are aware, with equity issuance of INR440 crores during the year and more recent fund tie-up of INR500 crores through NCDs, TMRW is now adequately funded with INR800 crores cash to pursue its aggressive growth plans.

items.statement: Demand normal in April and current quarter; inflation may pressure H2 demand.
items.quote: But we have seen demand nearly normal for most part of April and going into this quarter. So, as of now, while we feared a significant sort of risk on demand, as of now, we have not seen it play out.

items.statement: Pantaloons standalone margin 18-18.5% for quarter and year, slightly higher than last year.
items.quote: Pantaloons margin for the quarter, and I think for the year are also between 18% to 18.5%, which is the margin that Pantaloons has consistently delivered slightly higher than last year.

items.statement: Pantaloons online share 3-4% of business, plans to scale profitably.
items.quote: Today, it's about 3%, 4% of our business. It's not very large. But with all the shifts we have made this year, we feel confident of scaling up this business.

items.statement: Inflationary pressures may fully play out over next 3-4 months, risking demand in H2.
items.quote: Having said that, most of the inflationary pressures are perhaps still at work and may play out fully over the next 3 to 4 months. And therefore, consequent sort of pressure on demand is something that we'll have to wait and watch for in the second half of the year.

items.statement: Ethnic business FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 560 bps to 10.8%.
items.quote: Profitability improved significantly with FY '26 EBITDA margin expanding by 560 basis points to 10.8%.

items.statement: FY28 standalone revenue guidance of another 25% growth, roughly INR 7,500 crore.
items.quote: for FY28, from there we are looking at another 25% guidance, so that will roughly translate into INR 7,500 crores.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of around 12%.
items.quote: The EBITDA will continue to be around 12% for FY27.

items.statement: Expects new order inflow of around INR 15,000 crore in FY27.
items.quote: we are expecting an overall new order book of around INR 15,000 crores in FY27

items.statement: FY27 capex target of INR 150 crore.
items.quote: CAPEX for Financial Year ‘27, we are targeting INR 150 crores.

items.statement: Solar EPC revenue target of INR 600 crore in FY27 and INR 1,400 crore in FY28.
items.quote: We are targeting around INR 600 crores in FY27, and INR 1,400 crores in FY28.

items.statement: Mining EPC revenue target of INR 400 crore in FY27 and INR 600 crore in FY28.
items.quote: we are expecting another INR 400 crores turnover in FY27 , and in FY28, we are expecting around INR 600 crores.

items.statement: Jal Jeevan Mission revenue target of INR 750 crore in FY27.
items.quote: for FY27, we are targeting INR 750 crores in revenue, with the hope that the government will release more and more funds for this project, both central and state.

items.statement: Varanasi-Kolkata packages expected to contribute INR 1,600-1,800 crore revenue in FY27.
items.quote: going forward in FY27, we are looking at around INR 1,600 crores to INR 1,800 crores revenue from these packages.

items.statement: Pune Ring Road and Jalna-Nanded expected to contribute INR 1,500-1,600 crore revenue in FY27.
items.quote: we are targeting around INR 1,500 crores to INR 1,600 crores in FY27 from these two projects

items.statement: Bitumen price escalation compensation mechanism from April 1, 2026, to mitigate margin pressure.
items.quote: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways introduced cost escalation compensation mechanism for national highway projects executed on EPC, HAM, PBMC modes, payable from 1st April 2026

items.statement: Margin pressure expected in Q1/Q2 due to commodity price volatility, but recovery in Q3/Q4.
items.quote: Certainly, there will be pressure on our margins given the current scenario.

items.statement: Remaining equity investment of INR 542 crore to be invested over next 2 years; INR 350 crore in FY27.
items.quote: Out of INR 542 crores, around INR 350 crores will be infused in current Financial Year ‘27 and the balance will be in Financial Year ‘28.

items.statement: Targeting 60-70% of new orders from highways, rest from non-highways sectors.
items.quote: 60% to 70%, we are still targeting the highways sector because NHAI has declared that they are coming out with a large number of highways projects, both on HAM and as well as BOT Toll apart from the EPC.

items.statement: Acquiring Randstad Technology and Consulting Services business in Europe and Australia with €469M annualized revenue and €160M enterprise value
items.quote: The technology and consulting services business across these two big markets comes to annualized revenue of €469 million and we have a proposed enterprise value of €160 million on a cash free, debt free basis.

items.statement: No material EBIT margin impact this year or next year after deal closure
items.quote: So for us, the contribution to the value come from the three aspects of deal one, deal two, and deal three and in summary, I just want to say, there is going to be no material impact to the margin, for this year, even after closure and for the next year, we have plan in place to make sure that there is no material impact.

items.statement: Initial GCC partnership scope of $55-60M TCV over five years with Randstad Group
items.quote: Look, I think the initial scope that we will ramp up will be closer to 50 to 60 million TCV, because it is a five-year relationship, but you have to start with some scope to begin with.

items.statement: Europe top 25 clients contribute 65% revenue; Australia top 10 contribute 80% revenue
items.quote: In Europe, the top 25 customers contribute 65% of the revenue. In Australia, top 10 customers contribute to 80% of the revenue.

items.statement: Acquisition adds aerospace, defense, automotive, utilities verticals and cybersecurity, industrial AI capabilities
items.quote: The verticals of aerospace, defense, automotive, and utilities, which includes some of the marquee logos from the telecom sector and the regional banks is completely white space for us.

items.statement: May trim additional tail accounts short-term to focus on scaled marquee accounts
items.quote: My view is that I would assume a little bit more haircut in the short term just to transform, the scaled accounts, I mean, these are marquee accounts.

items.statement: Deal funded from cash; consideration 10-15% of balance sheet cash
items.quote: If you look at the cash on our balance sheet and the consideration that you are going to be paying for this transaction, it is not going to be more than 10% to 15%.

items.statement: Target onsite gross margin better than LTM's; offshore leverage to improve margins
items.quote: I think on the margin front, I can say that their gross margin on the onsite side is actually pretty good. I think what Venu touched upon right now in terms of the limited offshore model which they had, if you take that out, the onsite margin is pretty good.

items.statement: Targets 10-15% operating revenue growth for FY27.
items.quote: Firstly, we are looking to grow Operating revenues by 10%-15% for the year.

items.statement: Guides FY27 EBITDA margin band of 17-19%, lower than last year due to cost inflation.
items.quote: Secondly, we are giving an EBITDA margin band guidance of 17%-19%. This guidance is lower than last year on back of increased costs due to escalation in the prices of paper/logistics/transportation/packaging due to currency depreciation and higher fuel prices in the current year

items.statement: Targets content licensing revenues of more than Rs400m in FY27.
items.quote: Fifth, We are looking to target revenues more than Rs400m in the Content Licensing opportunities of our text, images and videos repositories and growing the number of clients.

items.statement: Expects operating cash flow over Rs1,000m for FY27.
items.quote: We expect to deliver OCF of over Rs1,000m for FY27.

items.statement: Plans capex of about Rs20 crores, mainly for a new printing plant near Delhi.
items.quote: Considering we have a capex of about Rs20 crores coming up, I would say, we should be around Rs130 crores, Rs135 crores.

items.statement: Expects paper and other raw material prices to increase 10-15% this year.
items.quote: Paper prices, definitely, we expect to grow by 10% to 15% this year at least, maybe more also.

items.statement: Plans to take price hikes of 6-8% to partially offset cost increases.
items.quote: We expect that the price hike would be in the range of 6% to 8%. That's only maximum we can take.

items.statement: Expects complete adoption of new syllabus books for K-12 over FY27-28, supporting growth.
items.quote: On back of this development, we expect FY27-28 to see complete adoption of the new syllabus books for the K-12 segment which should strongly support our growth trajectory over the next 2 years.

items.statement: Aims to build content licensing into at least a Rs100 crores business in a few years.
items.quote: And hopefully, we're trying to build it up to at least Rs100 crores business.

items.statement: CPD Singapore acquisition has potential to be US$8-10 Mn business in a few years.
items.quote: We believe this has the potential to be an US$8-US$10 Mn business in a few years.

items.statement: Middle East war impacted collections; receivables and inventory expected to normalize in 1HFY27.
items.quote: We expect Receivables and Inventory to normalize during the 1H of FY27.

items.statement: Higher education share fell from 20% pre-COVID to 8% currently; school segment grew 20-25%.
items.quote: Just to add to that, pre -COVID, higher education constituted almost 20% of our market. Currently, it's about 8%. So, the degrowth has happened in the higher education segment. The school segment continues to still grow. So, we are higher by about 20% to 25 % in the school segment.

items.statement: Considering buyback but waiting for war situation to settle; cash position expected at Rs130-135 crores next year.
items.quote: Yes, yes, we are considering that. Unfortunately, because of the war situation, we are waiting for things to settle down because it's best to have cash in books for this uncertain period.

items.statement: Plans small capital investment of Rs5-7 crores over next 2-3 years for international business expansion.
items.quote: So, we are not going to spend too much of money, maybe a small capital investment in the next 2 to 3 years of maybe Rs5 crores to Rs7 crores, nothing large, nothing major.

items.statement: Management guides over 15% revenue growth for FY27, excluding potential price retrigger benefits.
items.quote: I do expect that even on a conservative level, I am happy to give a guidance of over a 15% growth in the overall revenue.

items.statement: Company aims to double revenues every three to four years with improving margins and returns.
items.quote: we expect to double our revenues every three to four years with consistent improvements in margins and return on investments.

items.statement: FY27 capex expected at INR 275-310 crores, 5-7% of revenues, including growth, maintenance and upgradation.
items.value: INR 275 crores to around INR 310 crores
items.quote: you can expect somehow capital outlay of INR 275 crores to around INR 310 crores for the upcoming financial year, which will include a part of growth CapEx, part of maintenance CapEx, part of upgradation CapEx

items.statement: Existing projects expected to improve EBITDA margins by about 0.25% in FY27.
items.quote: yes we could expect a growth of 0.25% in EBITDA margins.

items.statement: EBITDA margins expected to remain around 11% while absolute returns and ROCE improve with volumes.
items.quote: while EBITDA levels will remain constant around 11%, but with the volumes coming up and the revenue going up, automatically in terms of absolute returns, our multiplier will be giving us a more return on capital employed.

items.statement: Targets post-tax ROCE improving from 15% to a peak of 20%.
items.quote: we are targeting an improvement return on capital employed starting with a post-tax return of 15%, going something at a highest peak of 20%.

items.statement: At INR 10,000 crores revenue, expects PAT of around INR 450 crores.
items.quote: on a INR 10,000 crores of revenue, we could be in a position to generate a PAT of around INR 450 crores

items.statement: New projects with INR 342 crores investment generated INR 468 crores revenue; expected to reach around INR 750 crores in FY27.
items.quote: around INR 750 crores of revenue these projects can do. 468 they have already delivered.

items.statement: EV business revenue expected to double in FY27 but remain loss-making until FY28 turnaround.
items.quote: This year, we expect the revenues to approximately double, but there would be losses again as we are trying to develop more new products also and capturing new markets.

items.statement: Overseas business faces aluminum price pass-through lag; Q1 FY27 may see dip before recovery.
items.quote: with the recent increase in aluminum prices, we might find a little bit of a dip in Quarter 1, but once the regenerative cycle of the pass-through of aluminum prices comes through, we are back on track

items.statement: Pricing retrigger mechanism likely activated due to rising input costs, benefiting company versus older customer pricing.
items.quote: there will be a pricing retrigger mechanism that will be activated, and sometimes this becomes positive for the company because many costs or pricing that has been done by the customer was done years ago

items.statement: Demand outlook very positive, especially two-wheelers; industry lost 200,000-300,000 vehicles in April due to manpower issues.
items.quote: the entire industry, according to my understanding, would have lost somewhere in the region of almost 200,000 to 300,000 vehicles.

items.statement: Manpower availability and rising state minimum wages (30-50%) pose significant industry-wide risk.
items.quote: various state governments increasing the minimum wages by almost 30% to 40%. And yesterday, Karnataka giving an indication that that could be even higher than 50%

items.statement: Term loans of INR 384 crores to be repaid over 3-4 years; FY27 repayment commitment around INR 103 crores.
items.quote: This year we have a repayment commitment of around close to INR 103 crores with various banks.

items.statement: Committed to 15-20% YoY revenue growth and ~20% EBITDA margin in medium term.
items.quote: So we are, as a team, fully committed to enhancing the revenue by 15% to 20% year-on-year, and achieving EBITDA of closer to 20-odd percent in the medium term, and we continue to work on that journey.

items.statement: FY27 capex expected around INR110 crores, including announced projects and maintenance.
items.quote: Yes. INR110 crores -- I mean, broadly, yes. Yes, broadly. It can go -- maybe it can go up depending on more projects through the year. But at the moment, yes, that's correct.

items.statement: Two approved expansion projects total about INR90+ crores; maintenance capex INR20-25 crores annually.
items.quote: Yes. So capex, these 2 capex, which I already said earlier, is about INR90 plus crores. There's maintenance capex of roughly INR20 crores, INR25 crores a year, which should continue.

items.statement: INR75 crores solar plant with battery storage to be commissioned in Q1 FY27, covering 61% of power needs.
items.quote: The company is further investing INR75 crores towards setting up a 20-megawatt ground-mounted solar plant with a battery energy storage system, which will further reduce the overall power cost, and the same is expected to be commissioned in this quarter, Q1 FY27.

items.statement: Solar plant expected to deliver about INR28 crores EBITDA-level cost savings in FY27.
items.quote: Yes. So that will be -- that is estimated to be about INR28 crores at EBITDA level, for FY27.

items.statement: Price hikes of 8-10% taken in glassware and opalware to cover cost inflation; full benefit may take 1-2 quarters.
items.quote: It's more because to get customers to accept substantially higher pricing, let's say, 8% to 10%, which is what prices we have taken, that takes a bit of time.

items.statement: Direct gas cost increased from INR20 crores to INR50 crores per annum due to West Asia crisis.
items.quote: Increased to INR50 crores.

items.statement: In-house manufacturing of vacuum bottles expected to improve gross margin by at least 10%, but not in first couple of quarters.
items.quote: But my sense is on the gross margin side, 10% at least we should get an increase. Otherwise, there's no benefit of manufacturing in India, so -- but I don't think that will be realized in like the first couple of quarters.

items.statement: Opalware demand growth muted; expects muted growth for next year or so.
items.quote: And we are working on that, but at the moment, I think we are -- for the next year or so, I think we are going to expect to see muted growth.

items.statement: Chinese dumping in borosilicate glass continues to pressure margins despite rupee depreciation.
items.quote: So that will, over a period of time, definitely cause some pressure on the margins. We can only keep working on innovation and petitioning the government to kind of create a level playing field, which we're trying to do.

items.statement: Anti-dumping investigation on borosilicate glass may take 6-9 months for outcome.
items.quote: At present data is under the investigation, but we hope that it at least it will take 6 to 9 months from now

items.statement: Debt may increase in short term but no major fundraising planned; operating cash flow sufficient for capex.
items.quote: Not much debt, right? I mean, it may go up in the short term, but we also have reason -- I mentioned our operating cash flow was about INR120 crores.

items.statement: Hydra inventory largely depleted; appliance inventory built up due to QCO, expected to correct.
items.quote: The Hydra inventory, whatever we built up last year is more or less all depleted. But on the flip side, we had to build up a lot of appliance inventory this year because of this QCO, which has come on a large range of appliances.

items.statement: Expects some challenges in next quarter or two before stabilizing.
items.quote: I do expect the next quarter or 2, we are still settling or still reaching lever, there are to be some challenges in the short run.

items.statement: Expects revenue growth of 15-20% for FY27, maintaining earlier guidance.
items.quote: Sir, we are expecting a revenue increase of about 15% to 20%, as we have given the earlier guidance also. So that expectation we are having even for this year.

items.statement: Reiterates target to achieve INR 3,000 crores revenue by March 2031.
items.quote: No, no. We are very much intact, and we have a plan to achieve this INR 3,000 crores by March 2031. So that plan is already in place, and we are working very rigorously on that plan.

items.statement: Projects EBITDA margin of 18-20% for FY27.
items.quote: Our margin ranges we have projected 18% to 20% EBITDA margin. So margin will be in that range only.

items.statement: Plans capex of INR 45 crores for India Pesticides and INR 90 crores for subsidiary in FY27, funded via internal accruals.
items.quote: Our capex plan for India Pesticides is INR 45 crores and for our 100% subsidiary, it is INR 90 crores. And mainly, it will be funded through internal accruals.

items.statement: Expects Shalvis facility revenue of INR 70-80 crores in FY27, including new block.
items.quote: No, just now we answered, the revenue from the Shalvis facility will be around INR 70 crores to INR 80 crores in this financial year, FY27, including the new block, what we are going to construct.

items.statement: Successfully passed on some raw material cost increases to customers, aiming to maintain prices.
items.quote: But we also have discussed with our customers, and we have tried to pass on the cost differential to our customer, and we have been successful in convincing them for some of the products. And we feel that we should be able to maintain these prices in the coming months.

items.statement: Japanese partner forecast for this year and next is 30% higher than last year; discussing new molecule.
items.quote: That is going on well, sir. Actually, we are having regular discussions with our Japanese friends, and they have given the forecast for this year and for the next year, which is almost 30% more than last year.

items.statement: Expects full capacity utilization of PEDA and Pretilachlor in FY27 after capacity expansion.
items.quote: Sir, FY27, I think we will be utilizing the full capacity of the products because we increased the capacity last quarter, which was commissioned only in March. So we hope that this year, we should be able to utilize fully.

items.statement: Monsoon forecast 6-8% below normal may not significantly impact production, but El Niño uncertainty remains.
items.quote: Yes. See, we know that IMD has given a forecast of reduced rainfall this season from 6% to 8%. But the previous history, what we have gone through, there was news item in the papers that in the past also, there has been occasions where the rainfall was less, but the overall production did not get suffered.

items.statement: Net working capital days expected to improve by 10-12 days by FY27.
items.quote: And our net working capital days has now improved to 223. There is a slight scope for further improvement, maybe by 10 to 12 days less by FY27.

items.statement: Shalvis expected to contribute INR 1,000 crores revenue by March 2031; rest from existing plants.
items.quote: Yes. By March 2031, we expect to reach INR 3,000 crores. And thereby, we have got plans already in place. In Shalvis, we expect the total revenue by March 2031 to be about INR 1,000 crores. And rest, we will be generating from our existing plants at Dewa Road, Sandila and our formulation facilities.

items.statement: Supply chain critical; long-term supplier arrangements and customer discussions mitigate price increases.
